name: Academy Doctor
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: STARFLEET ACADEMY
FACTION: FEDERATION

Everyone’s favorite EMH began life as the medical program Mark I. Iterations on this program eventually yielded the Doctor we know today. With photons and force fields in place of flesh and blood, the Doctor has had to fight for his place in the galaxy. His work has been influential in furthering hologram rights, and the acceptance of non-organic sentient beings.

With his diverse knowledge base and wealth of experience, this renaissance EMH is the perfect being to educate the first generation of cadets since the Burn. As chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Athena and professor of Xenobiology, the Doctor will have an important role in shaping the Starfleet of the future.

name: Alexander Marcus
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: SECTION 31
FACTION: FEDERATION

Alexander Marcus was a senior admiral in Starfleet and a member of Section 31, the clandestine organization hidden within the Federation. Admiral Marcus spearheaded the significant military build-up of Starfleet forces after the Nero incident; he viewed the Klingon Empire as a grave threat to the Federation, and believed war with them was inevitable.

Kirk and Khan worked together to put an end to Alexander Marcus's scheme to strike the Klingon homeworld of Kronos, though the alliance didn't last.

name: Ambassador Spock
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: IDIC
FACTION: FEDERATION

It would take volumes to justly recount the life and achievements of the one known as Spock, arguably Vulcan’s most famous son. Though of course, he was a child of two worlds, because his mother came from Earth. His accolades and exploits serving aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, alongside his lifelong friends and colleagues, James T. Kirk and Leonard McCoy, are well documented elsewhere. Here, we are more concerned with his accomplishments in later life. From representing the Federation as a special envoy, which led to its historic peace accords with the Klingon Empire, to later forging the path towards the reunification of the Romulan and Vulcan peoples, one cannot consider the legacy of the galaxy without also considering Spock’s far-reaching influence.

It was nearly a century after his influential work with the Klingons that the other great power, the Romulan Star Empire, came under grave threat. Once again, Spock answered the call. Their star, Romulus, was on the verge of going supernova, and the Federation’s evacuation of Romulan citizens had failed. Spock planned to release red matter to create a black hole in the path of the supernova, which would absorb its energy and save countless Romulan lives. However, the supernova occurred sooner than he expected. Planet Romulus was destroyed before Spock could deploy the red matter, which he eventually did, minimizing further casualties. But his ship, the Jellyfish, was pulled inside the black hole - along with the vessel of Nero, a Romulan miner who’d lost his entire family in the destruction of Romulus, and had vowed revenge on Spock for his failure.

Spock was sent into the distant past, emerging in 2258. But Nero was waiting for him. He marooned Spock on Delta Vega, before using his powerful ship to destroy Vulcan, forcing Spock to share his fate. Despite the emotional devastation wrought, Spock resolved to help the surviving Vulcans rebuild their culture, founding the colony of New Vulcan, and tending it for the remainder of his days.

name: Andy Billups
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: INTERCEPTOR STRIKE TEAM
FACTION: FEDERATION

A top-notch engineer, an attentive mentor, an inspiring role model, and a dedicated Starfleet officer - this is the reputation that Andy Billups built for himself during his career aboard the U.S.S. Cerritos. Although battle-ready and courageous, he remains shy and humble, dedicating most of his time to his engineering duties and tending to his beloved warp core.

Among the halls and chambers of Hysperian castles, Andy is addressed by his title, Prince Andarithio; a formality typically reserved for Hysperian royalty. Lieutenant Billups chose to abdicate his birthright in order to serve in Starfleet, but such a decision wasn’t eagerly accepted by his mother, Queen Paolana. She has utilized all the tricks in her book to make Andarithio take a consort and claim the Hysperian throne. However, much to the joy of his fellow Cerritos crew, the Queen’s efforts failed, merely reinforcing Billups’ resolve to remain serving as a Starfleet engineer.

name: Annorax
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: VOYAGER 30TH ANNIVERSARY
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

If you could save your people from destruction while damning yourself in the process, would you do it?
Annorax of the Krenim Imperium was a brilliant man. Intelligent, cunning, and fiercely devoted to his people. He pledged to stop at nothing to restore the Krenim to their rightful place as a dominant power in the galaxy.
Desperate to protect his people from their age-old enemies, the Rinar, Annorax discovered a method of pushing elements out of the space-time continuum, thereby creating an alternate timeline where that element never existed.
This science was weaponized immediately.
In the years that followed, the Krenim became an unstoppable force in the Delta Quadrant. That is, until they were ultimately defeated by Kathryn Janeway and the crew of the U.S.S. Voyager.
Driven by naught but an unquenchable desire for revenge against Janeway, Annorax has launched a full-scale temporal invasion of the Alpha Quadrant. This time, we may not have Janeway to save us...

name: Beckett Mariner
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: LOWER DECKS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Some might say that Ensign Beckett Mariner is a loose cannon. And they would be right. She is a self-proclaimed kicker of asses and breaker of protocol, because protocol is for people who need to be told what to do. And Mariner certainly isn’t one of those people. 

That is not to say that Mariner is not a capable Starfleet officer - quite the contrary. Top of her class and predicted to be the first of her cohort to become a Captain, Mariner does not lack the skill necessary for a higher rank. She is simply more interested in the adventure that a life in the Lower Decks can offer than a stifling role as a member of senior staff. Or perhaps she simply wants to carve out her own path, instead of following in the footsteps of her Captain mother and Admiral father. 

Ensign Mariner has spent time on five different Starfleet vessels, along with a stint on Deep Space 9. She has seen some stuff. She spent time in a sentient cave, and a Klingon prison where she had to fight a yeti for her shoes. She was almost decapitated by a singing crystal, and blood-bonded with a fearsome Klingon warrior. These experiences taught her how to think on her feet, and think for herself.

Mariner’s ability to adapt to any situation, and think outside the box, are the envy of her straight-laced friend Bradward Boimler, who is often unwillingly drawn into her schemes and escapades. But while Ensign Mariner always seems to be finding (or starting) trouble, her friends and crew know that she always has their back and their best interests at heart.

name: Benjamin Sisko
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: DEEP SPACE NINE
FACTION: FEDERATION

Captain Benjamin Sisko is the iconic commander of Deep Space 9, a charismatic leader and a loving father. And if running a space station and raising his son Jake weren’t enough, Sisko also has the burden of being the newly liberated Bajor’s protector and spiritual leader, a task he has settled into over time, showing his ability to rise to even the most demanding of challenges. 

In spite of his success as Deep Space 9’s commander, Sisko’s arrival to the station was not an enthusiastic one. A few years prior, he was involved in the battle of Wolf 359, a Borg attack in the Sol system. He tragically lost his wife in this battle, but his son, Jake, lived. Sisko considered resigning from Starfleet in light of his grief and new single-parenthood, but ultimately accepted that his place was aboard Deep Space 9.

On his first visit to Bajor, Sisko was pronounced the Emissary of the Prophets, the aliens who live in the wormhole, or “Celestial Temple”. Sisko would encounter the Prophets various times in the subsequent years, and would even fulfill ancient Bajoran prophecies, cementing his role as the Emissary. He would eventually discover that his own mother was a Prophet, and that “the Sisko’s” existence was by design.

Sisko is very proud of his New Orleans heritage, and has retained his father’s love of cooking creole food with fresh, non-replicated ingredients. When he is not communing with the Prophets, putting out diplomatic fires, or dealing with the looming threat of war, he is known to throw dinner parties for his friends aboard Deep Space 9.

name: Borg Queen
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND 
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: BORG

"I am the beginning, the end, the one who is many. I am the Borg."
A menacing and enigmatic creature, the Borg Queen remains a mystery for the whole Universe. She is the leader of the Collective; an emotional individual among the impassive drones, a perfect synergy of organic and synthetic. 
The Queen exists for one purpose - protect the Collective by bringing order to chaos and exploit emotions to get what she wants. If the drones always seek the opportunity to assimilate the desired species on sight, the Queen applies her empathy skills to make beneficial alliances and gain an advantageous position. But one must never forget, that even though the Queen may look and act like a friend, she is the Borg, and sooner or later you will be assimilated.

name: Carol Freeman
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: LOWER DECKS
FACTION: FEDERATION

When it comes to undertaking the missions that nobody else wants, a firmly resolute disposition is a base requirement for the job. Luckily for other more egotistical Starfleet personnel, Captain Carol Freeman is ready and able to accept the role of underdog. Although the U.S.S. Cerritos endured a less-than-stellar reputation in the earliest days following its commission, Freeman’s guidance and command have ensured that the ship’s standing as one of the Federation’s darkest horses endures to this day.

During her time as captain, the line separating Freeman’s work life from her home life was permanently blurred; together with her husband and four-star flag officer, Admiral Alonzo Freeman, the pair share both parentage and command of one Ensign Beckett Mariner. Due to Mariner’s dubious honor of being one of the fleet’s most demerited officers, Freeman saw fit to conceal the true nature of their relationship from the rest of the Cerritos crew. Over the years, Mariner’s unruly and disruptive behavior has been a persistent thorn in Freeman’s side. However, through a multitude of shared trials and tribulations, the pair have developed a mutual respect for each other’s strengths and ambitions. While their personalities often clash, their contrasting methods of taking action often lead them and their fellow crew to victory.

Although frequently frustrated by Starfleet command’s failure to recognize the achievements of her crew, Freeman continues taking the jobs that nobody else wants - because, at the end of the day, somebody has to. Her California-class ship might not be the biggest, but don’t be fooled; Carol Freeman remains a courageous, albeit underappreciated, commanding officer.

name: Carol Marcus
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: AUXILIARY CONTROLS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Born to the famous Starfleet Admiral, Alexander Marcus, and raised in London, Carol Marcus has been exceptional from the beginning. She is one of Starfleet’s most valued science officers, with a particular eye for advanced weapons. Carol was a part of the U.S.S. Enterprise crew that stopped Khan during his attack on Earth.

name: Cat Spock
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: IDIC
FACTION: FEDERATION

What is there to say about Spock, except that he is a cat? Except he isn’t a cat, but rather half cat, half le-catya - a Vulcan species that bears remarkable similarities to Earth’s Felis catus. As a Vulcan, Spock is deeply rooted in logic, spiritualism, and philosophy. Vulcans maintain strong emotions beneath their fur; coupled with the turbulent emotions of an Earth cat, Spock’s day-to-day life is a constant battle to remain in control - notably having never completed kolinahr to attain a state of pure logic. That Spock appears entirely logical to his friends and colleagues is a testament to his mental discipline and strong catra.

But Spock is also much more than the sum of his rather cute parts. Still early in his career as a Starfleet officer (having shunned the Vulcan Science Academy), and certainly early in his life as a le-catya, he had already accomplished much aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, while still only a junior lieutenant and science officer. Needless to say, he soon rose to the rank of first officer. There, with his close comrades, Captain James T. Kirk and Doctor Leonard McCoy, he has out-thought Klingons, rediscovered the Romulans, and even found time for love with his fiancée, T’Pring. Oh, and he once also lost his brain for a short while (haven’t all cats?).

Everything now points to a long and successful career for Spock. But ultimately, being a cat, primal urges are a constant threat to someone even as disciplined as Spock. One can never be too certain what is waiting around the corner.

name: Chakotay
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: VOYAGER
FACTION: FEDERATION

Brave, noble, and self-sacrificing, Chakotay is a man for whom the righteous path is the only path, no matter how hard it might be. He even resigned from Starfleet in order to join the Maquis, a resistance group fighting against the Cardassian occupation of their homes, made legal by the signing of the Federation Cardassian Treaties. 

Chakotay’s father, Kolopak, was killed defending his colony from the Cardassians. Until that moment, Chakotay had been dismissive of his Native American heritage, believing the ways of his people to be backward and too rooted in myth. Indeed, he and his father were estranged because of this.

However, Kolopak’s death reconnected Chakotay with his culture and now he carries his ancestry proudly with him wherever he goes, even into the depths of the Delta Quadrant. There, his pragmatic nature saw him join forces with the crew of U.S.S. Voyager, forging profound friendships as they stood shoulder to shoulder in their long search for a way home.

Chakotay may have begun his journey distancing himself from the ways of his people, but in the end it was Chakotay who took those ways further than anyone else in the proud history of his ancestors.

name: Chancellor Ake
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STARFLEET ACADEMY
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

Chancellor Nahla Ake has lived long enough to watch the Federation rise, fracture, and begin to heal again. A half-Lanthanite with centuries of experience behind her, she carries the weight of history with quiet grace and an irreverent streak that often leaves cadets struggling to decide whether they are being disciplined or inspired. 

Ake walked away from Starfleet after a choice that haunted her for decades — obeying the law at the cost of her conscience. The Burn took even more from her, including her son, yet Nahla Ake refused to let grief turn her bitter. Instead, she returned to Starfleet Academy to guide a new generation on board the U.S.S. Athena.

Chancellor Ake believes the purpose of Starfleet is not perfection, but compassion. She teaches cadets that diplomacy can be stronger than force, that curiosity matters as much as courage, and that failure is never the end of a journey. Beneath her relaxed demeanor and playful eccentricities lies the mind of a seasoned commander who has survived centuries of impossible choices and impossible odds.

Whether standing against pirates, challenging the rigidity of Starfleet tradition, or helping lost cadets find their place among the stars, Nahla Ake reminds the Federation what Starfleet was always meant to be: not simply explorers or soldiers, but people willing to believe in a better future — even after living through its darkest days.

name: Christopher Pike
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: SHAKEDOWN CRUISE
FACTION: FEDERATION

The first captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise, Christopher Pike is known for being strong, defiant and unwaveringly loyal to Starfleet. He was forced to give up command of the ship when he was taken captive by Nero. After the defeat of the Narada, Pike was promoted to the rank of Admiral and continues to serve as one of Starfleet’s most decorated and well-respected officers.

name: D'Vana Tendi
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: LOWER DECKS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Ensign D’Vana Tendi is equal to any task she sets her mind to, something which has impressed senior management on the Cerritos, and has led to her being transferred to senior science officer training. It is her endless enthusiasm and optimism that allows her to approach even the most menial and undesirable tasks with a gusto heretofore unseen in the Lower Decks crew. Tendi sees every task as an opportunity to learn and grow, though she sometimes takes this mindset to the extreme.

As an Orion in Starfleet, Tendi has faced her fair share of challenges. Tendi has left her life with the Orion Syndicate in the past, but she remains sensitive to Orion stereotypes. She wants to be seen first as a Starfleet officer, not a thief or a pirate. Though, when the situation calls for it, the feared and respected Mistress of the Winter Constellations can be called upon to make an appearance.

Tendi is, above all else, a caring friend. When her best friend Rutherford lost his memory, including his memory of their friendship, she reacted only with excitement that they had the opportunity to become best friends all over again. In addition to spending time with her friends, Tendi is fond of archival cataloging, hand-editing DNA sequences, and listening to Klingon acid punk rock music.

name: Dajash Tolra
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: SYMBIOSIS
FACTION: NONE

When you are the daughter of one of Cardassia’s most important households, certain things are expected of you. You are meant to behave in a certain way, hold yourself to a certain standard, be a credit to your family. Dajash Tolra’s life was mapped out for her before she was born. She was raised to become a good, conscientious wife, and educated to enter the sciences should that path be closed.

But the life of a dutiful daughter of Cardassia was not the life Dajash wanted for herself, and so she rebelled, choosing instead a life of crime. Fiercely intelligent, she found she had a gift for safecracking, and she used it.

Now she is a fugitive from the Cardassian Empire, on the run after breaking into the wrong Legate’s vaults. Razor sharp, sardonic and sarcastic, she always found it hard to be anything more than a lone agent. Until she joined the crew of the Trill adventurer Masriad Vael, where she uses her unique skills to help her boss liberate some of the galaxy’s rarest and most valuable items from the galaxy’s most undeserving.

name: Data
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: TNG CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

Although he’s one of the most advanced technologies in the universe, in both his mental and physical abilities, what’s most remarkable about the U.S.S. Enterprise-D’s resident android officer is his humanity. Throughout his many adventures and challenges with the Enterprise crew, he has shown curiosity, a sense of humor, and even compassion. Furthermore, he often engages in the most human of hobbies, such as painting and reading.
While many have questioned whether or not Data can be considered a truly sentient being due to being an A.I., those who know him best believe that he is truly alive, having seen first hand his growth, both as an officer and as a friend.

name: Deanna Troi
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: TNG CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

An empathic guide, and a voice of conscience.

Deanna Troi is the half-human, half-Betazoid counselor aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Her passion for the emotional wellbeing of her fellow crewmates is only rivalled by her love of chocolate. As a member of the senior staff, and a regular presence on the bridge, Troi has become an invaluable advisor to Captain Picard in times of great strife. Her expertise has placed her front and center during many first contact situations, with her empathic abilities - being able to read the emotions of others - a key tool in sensing vital information at critical times.

Troi is a beloved member of the Enterprise crew, and in her downtime enjoys socializing with her friends in Ten Forward, exercising, or joining the weekly poker night. Deanna has a close relationship with her mother, Lwaxanna Troi, who frequently visits the Enterprise. Deanna is also quick to action and decisive when needs arise, and is a fully trained command officer.

name: Deidamia
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: STARFLEET ACADEMY
FACTION: KLINGON

Deidamia is descended from a clan who became nomads on a generational ship after the Burn. The original goal was to find a safer part of the galaxy to reestablish their colony, but through the generations, the clan grew attached to their spacer lifestyle. In Deidamia's time, they had grown to a fleet of humble traders, servicing busy hubs and remote corners of the galaxy both. 

Deidamia was happy in this life. At least, she believed she was. One day, the young spacer ignored her gut instinct and accepted a job she shouldn't have. She wanted the hefty reward, and she paid the ultimate price. Caught with stolen Federation tech, Deidamia was tried for a crime she did not know she was committing. Starfleet's harsh justice saw her locked up with a certain Klingarite as her neighbor. 

Nus Braka kept her sane in that prison. Kept her focused. Showed her the truth about the Federation and the wider galaxy. When Braka's crew mounted a prison break to retrieve their leader, Deidamia joined them and never looked back. 

Deidamia would do anything for the man who put her on this path and made her the pirate queen she is today. She would go to any lengths to get back to him. But sometimes, despite herself, she can't help but wonder what her life would be like if she had never met him. She can't help but imagine the person she would be now if she hadn't taken on that fateful delivery job, if she was still a simple trader making an honest living in a galaxy that didn't seem quite so dark.

name: Doctor T'Ana
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: LOWER DECKS
FACTION: FEDERATION

With a ship as prone to mishap as the U.S.S. Cerritos, only the most adept physicians would be capable of maintaining the health and integrity of the crew. In her role as chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Cerritos, Dr. T’Ana has proven time and time again to be just the right Caitian for the job.

Although prone to unleashing torrents of profanity at a moment’s notice, T’Ana has been capable of maintaining friendships and even romantic interests during her time onboard the Cerritos. Perhaps even more surprisingly, T’Ana has also taken a number of lower deckers under her wing - her mentorship of Ensign Tendi was instrumental in Tendi’s admission into the senior science officer’s training program. Even though T’Ana retained a temper as sharp as her claws, she has frequently demonstrated the capability to show affection for her fellow crewmates.

Contrary to the observations of certain Starfleet Ensigns, T’Ana is more than just a cat in a coat. From Galardonian rage viruses to mugato venom poisoning, if something is ailing you, then Dr. T’Ana likely has the cure... Just don’t expect a warm bedside manner while you recuperate.

name: Eleven of Eleven
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

An anomaly among Klingons, Barot chose a life of self-exile in the pursuit of knowledge and happiness away from the fixation on war and honor that often motivates his people. Though he alienated himself among his fellow Klingons, he was at peace with his decision. However, the sad irony is that Barot’s endeavor to walk his own path has now become meaningless, as he finds himself another one of the Borg’s homogenous drones. Today, Eleven of Eleven stands as a stark reminder that the Borg are not only indiscriminate when it comes to their choice of victims, but also of their terrifying ability to adapt and evolve based on the strength of those assimilated.

name: Enterprise-E Picard
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: ENTERPRISE-E
FACTION: FEDERATION

Captain Jean Luc Picard no longer simply sits in command of a starship, he sits as mentor and friend at the head of a family. For more than a decade, he has stood next to and over his crew, watched them grow and evolve into the exemplary and tight-knit unit he has come to love and trust implicitly, in mind, body and soul.

Although he is still haunted by memories of assimilation by the Borg, Picard’s sense of adventure and his spirit of exploration remain as strong as ever, as does his firm belief in the betterment of humanity and his conviction that dialogue and communication can achieve so much more than war ever could.

At this stage in his life, perhaps more than at any other, Captain Jean Luc Picard truly embodies the Platonic ideal of the Philosopher King.

name: Enterprise-E Riker
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: ENTERPRISE-E
FACTION: FEDERATION

It has been a long time coming, but after more than fifteen years as Jean-Luc Picard’s steadfast second in command and reliable right-hand man, William T. Riker has finally accepted the responsibility, and the honor, of commanding his own starship as captain of the U.S.S. Titan.

But if there was ever a man more capable and deserving of such awesome command, it’s Riker. His experiences on the Enterprise have taught him a lot, not just about keeping a cool head in a crisis but also trusting in the skills and abilities of your crew. Because being a captain is not just about issuing orders, it’s about knowing what your people can do.

And Riker knows people. It’s one of his greatest strengths, and those instincts will serve him well as captain. But he has one other great strength, and that is the love he has for his wife, the half-Betazoid empath Deanna Troi. With her by his side, there is nothing he cannot achieve.

name: Eurydice
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: OUTLAWS
FACTION: NONE

Born into poverty by parents who abandoned her, Eurydice had to learn how to survive on her own from an early age, spending her early years as a pirate and scavenger.  She quickly learned that knowing the right people can help you survive anywhere, as she became a black market arbiter, setting up sellers with buyers, specializing in ships and parts, and making a living off the small profits she earned along the way. 

Able to read almost anyone’s body language, she can be as manipulative or as straight-talking as any given deal needs her to be. Due to the cost of supporting a daughter, Eurydice tends to live payday to payday, though she harbors dreams of finding a better life for her family.

name: Ezri Dax
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: STATUS CONTROL TEAM
FACTION: FEDERATION

When a Trill humanoid is chosen to be joined with a Trill symbiont, they are typically provided with years of preparation and training. This ensures that the chosen recipient is aware of the ramifications of what they are about to undertake. Following the untimely passing of Jadzia Dax, the eighth host of the Dax symbiont, an unjoined Trill was called upon to temporarily act as a replacement host, until it could be safely carried back to the Trill homeworld, where a suitable permanent host could be found. Ezri Tigan, an ensign serving aboard the U.S.S. Destiny, was chosen for this task.

Unfortunately, en route back to the Trill homeworld, the Dax symbiont’s health deteriorated. If not joined permanently to a Trill host as soon as possible, the symbiont would not survive the journey home. Understanding the gravity of the situation, Ezri agreed to undergo the full joining procedure, permanently committing herself to serve as the ninth host of the Dax symbiont. In lieu of the years of expected training, Ezri was instead provided with a mere fifteen-minute briefing from the ship’s surgeon. Nonetheless, despite the fear and uncertainty, Ezri agreed to host the symbiont - a testament to her empathy and willingness to help others.

Following the successful joining procedure, the unjoined Trill known as Ezri Tigan was no more. Taking on the name of Ezri Dax in honor of her new identity as a joined Trill, she now played host not only to the symbiont, but also to the memories of all eight hosts who came before her. At the conclusion of a briefing with the Symbiosis Commission’s Evaluation Board, Ezri looked to Captain Benjamin Sisko for guidance, as he had been a good friend of the previous two hosts. Understanding that she could be a valuable addition to his crew, Captain Sisko requested Ezri stay on at Deep Space Nine to serve as the station’s counselor - a role she would go on to excel in.

name: FCM Data
bio:
CLASS: Command
GROUP: FIRST CONTACT MOVIE
FACTION: BORG

Lieutenant Commander Data is a true member of the Enterprise-E crew. Adventurous, imaginative, and idealistic, this Soong-type android has become as close to a human as anyone can. Surrounded by friends, he, in turn, became a great friend himself, earning the trust and loyalty of his fellow crew members. He will follow them wherever - or whenever - they go, and protect them at all costs.

And yet, Data is not a Human. When Picard’s crew followed the Collective into the past, the Borg Queen intended to use his desire to become a Human to turn Lieutenant Commander into her asset and ensure the failure of the Enterprise-E mission. She tried to sway him into obedience and join her side by grafting organic flesh to his body and abusing his emotion chip with raw, vivid feelings. And yet, there is one part of Data that nobody has ever managed to take control of - loyalty. 

No matter the time, space, or challenge that he needs to overcome, Lieutenant Commander Data will always come back to rescue his crewmates, to protect his friends, and to stand by his family.

name: Female Spock
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: IDIC
FACTION: FEDERATION

Hailing from an alternate timeline, created after Nero’s journey into the past, Spock’s life and career followed a similar trajectory to those in other timelines affected by these events. Spock enrolled in Starfleet Academy, and while studying there, met Nnamdi Uhuro. The pair bonded over their love of science, excelled academically, and soon became romantic partners. Initially displeased at being assigned to the Farragut during the Nero crisis, Uhuro convinced Spock, by then an Academy instructor, to alter the roster so that they too could serve aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

It was during this crisis that Spock witnessed events both devastating and miraculous - from the destruction of her home planet, Vulcan, with the loss of much of its people and culture, including her father, to the arrival of Ambassador Spock, her older self from the far future. When her duties allowed, Spock assisted the ambassador and the remaining Vulcan elders in the formation of New Vulcan, which is where she was reunited with her original bondmate, T’Pring.

Aboard the Enterprise, Spock also forged friendships that she knew would last a lifetime. This included Lea McCoy, Marjorie Scott, Pavlovna Chekov, Jason Rand, Keensera, and her eventual first officer, Hikari Sulu. She also remained good friends with Uhuro, despite having resumed her relationship with T’Pring. But it was with a certain captain of the Enterprise that Spock struck up her greatest friendship - the incomprehensible yet brilliant, Jane Tiberia Kirk. Jane’s death, saving the Enterprise hit Spock hard, and she felt immense guilt when she was later offered the captaincy. Ambassador Spock helped her through this difficult time, and when she later passed away, and Spock received her personal effects, it only confirmed the importance of friendship in her future.

name: Five of Eleven
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

No amount of ferocity, determination or fighting spirit will save you when the Borg come. Jaylah learned this lesson the hard way. The once soft spoken Starfleet cadet, who so famously survived alone against Krall and his Swarm had finally met a foe she could not evade. She was taken, along with several other of her fellow cadets and subjected to the horrors of Borg assimilation. As the last remnants of her free will were robbed from her, she cried a single tear. Not for herself, but for the friends she would be forced to hurt.

name: Four of Eleven
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

A respected scientist among Vulcans, Stonn is another to have fallen victim to the Borg’s control, alongside his partner T’Pring. Stonn’s dedication to protecting his family became meaningless once he was chosen and abducted for the sake of assimilation. As Four of Eleven, the former geologist and surveyor seems doomed to a life of fulfilling the whims of the Borg, and the peaceful future he once envisioned for his family now a distant memory.

name: Gabriel Lorca
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: TERRAN EMPIRE
FACTION: NONE

Captain Gabriel Lorca is one of Starfleet’s most decorated officers. During the Federation-Klingon war, Lorca was trusted with the command of the U.S.S. Discovery. This put him in a position to lead the conflict from the front lines, and develop highly experimental technologies that could mean life or death for Starfleet.

name: Gary Mitchell
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: AUXILIARY CONTROLS
FACTION: FEDERATION

An operations officer on the Enterprise with remarkable psionic potential for a human. Gary was a friend of Kirk's in the academy. Kirk advised Gary that in the academy you either think or sink; Gary took that notion to heart.

name: Geordi La Forge
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: TNG CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

For all the obstacles thrown at him, Geordi has never let anything keep him down for long. Driven by his unquenchable thirst for knowledge and a fascination with any and all technology in the known universe, he has become one of the most skilled and respected engineers of his generation. Meanwhile, his unerring work ethic and loyalty has earned him the respect of everyone around him.
But aside from his prodigious abilities in his field, Geordi is often the heart of the U.S.S. Enterprise-D crew. Treating everyone with the utmost request and kindness, to the point where even Data understood what friendship meant from his bond with Geordi, he is one of the most popular officers on board the Enterprise.

name: Georgiou
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: DISCOVERY
FACTION: FEDERATION

Despite a life filled with great loss, Philippa Georgiou never lost her hope for a brighter future. A true idealist, Georgiou sought to find the best in everyone. Her stalwart leadership, bright outlook and fierce determination made her a respected captain and a beloved friend.
She was also not one to let rules stop her from making the right decisions. She arguably went against General Order One when she allowed Saru, a member of a pre-warp civilization, to join Starfleet.
However, despite this, she was well respected by both her subordinates and superiors. Everyone knew that, when the chips were down, you could count on having Philippa Georgiou by your side.

name: Ghrush
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: SYNDICATE
FACTION: NONE

The Orion Syndicate was built as an organized crime unit that specialized in piracy, smuggling, slave-trading, and assassination. Over the years, the Syndicate has become the true power on Orion Prime and has dealings far and wide across the quadrant. As a trusted recruiter and Agent for the Syndicate, Ghrush is responsible for finding and manipulating those reckless enough to want a stake in the underworld’s high-risk rewards.

Ghrush is a diligent and methodical operative. What he lacks in subtlety, he makes up for in reactionary tactical thinking. Having gotten himself into more than a few difficult situations, he has learned to trust his instincts. Fight or flight has become his motto, and Ghrush values his life more than one single payday. He’d much rather risk the lives of initiates than put himself in danger, and as a public face for the Syndicate, he has plenty of opportunity for profit.

name: Gorkon
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: KLINGON PATRIOTS
FACTION: KLINGON EMPIRE

Gorkon, an accomplished general, is respected and feared by the Klingon Empire's enemies. He is seen as a rising star in Klingon politics, and is expected to take a seat on the High Council within the decade.

name: Gul Dukat
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: DS9
FACTION: CARDASSIAN

Dukat is a man with an infamously diverse range of accolades and condemnations over his years of service within the Cardassian Union. He is best known as the final Prefect of Bajor, a position that he held aboard the station Terok Nor. While presiding over Bajor, Dukat was held accountable for many of the atrocities that occurred in its final years. He would later refer to himself as a scapegoat, and spent the years after the Cardassian withdrawal from Bajor in roles of far lesser rank.

Dukat’s time as a lowly freighter captain was brightened only by the presence of his beloved daughter Ziyal. Ziyal, a half-Bajoran, was treated as an outcast upon her return to Cardassia, and it was partly in defense of his daughter that Dukat took his position out of the limelight, trawling the stars looking for opportunities. Ever the opportunist, Dukat has regularly found ways to reconnect with members of the Cardassian Central Command, and is never more than a short arm’s reach from reclaiming a position of power once again.

Though his name is etched in infamy across the quadrant, Dukat is a master manipulator, who has been able to coerce and defraud many, including numerous decorated Federation officers, and people of political importance on his home planet. There is a saying amongst those who know him. One should never turn one’s back on Gul Dukat. Even for survivors there may yet be a poisonous barb left under the surface that will fester.

name: Gwen DeMarco
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: GALAXY QUEST
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

The term “unsung hero” is thrown around a lot in Hollywood. However, nobody is more deserving of that moniker than Gwen DeMarco.
Possibly the most enthusiastic member of the original Galaxy Quest cast, Gwen had thrown everything behind the character of Lieutenant Tawny Madison. Despite her character being horribly mismanaged by the misogynistic writers of the time, Gwen never let it stop her from being the best version of herself she could be. She truly lived by the old saying, “no role is too small.”
Unlike most of the other cast members, Gwen would go on to maintain a fantastic relationship with the fans of the show. Where her cast-mates mocked the enthusiastic, die-hard viewers, or otherwise viewed them as little more than cash-cows, Gwen went out of her way to treat the fans with kindness and gratitude, aware that her career was built on their devotion.
During the Protector crew’s ill-fated space adventure, DeMarco proved to be a sharp, quick-witted bridge officer, throwing herself into life-threatening situations to save her friends. Along with Nesmith, she was able to brave the Chompers and activate the Omega-13 device, bringing about Sarris’ destruction.

name: Harcourt Fenton Mudd
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: OUTLAWS
FACTION: NONE

Harcourt Fenton Mudd. Many call him a thief, a liar, a rogue, a con-man. He is all of these things. But he is, above all, a survivor.
Arriving in our universe through a complicated series of mycellial networks, this alternate Mudd might, at first, seem similar to our own. Indeed, he is charming, quick witted and incredibly intelligent but this Mudd has one crucial differentiating factor. There is no line he will not cross.
The cruel fate he suffered at the hands of Klingon captors hardened Mudd, turning him ruthless. It showed him that there can be no room for morals in the fight for survival. This new outlook, as well as his penchant for cons and thievery, put him at odds with the crew of the U.S.S. Discovery, who have proven to be a mighty thorn in his side. Now that Mudd is here, he will do whatever it takes to make it out alive… and maybe wreak a little havoc while he’s at it.

name: Harry Mudd
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: MUDD'S CREW
FACTION: ROGUES

Harcourt Fenton Mudd. Thief. Swindler and con man. Liar and rogue. He goes by many pejoratives, but perhaps the most accurate of them all is opportunist. For years, Mudd has made a living by trying to con and extort everyone he’s ever met. 
Though he always gives different accounts of where he came from, one element of his story always remains the same: his claims to have faced injustices that many will never know. With that chip on his shoulder, he believes in taking what he wants, and doing whatever necessary to get ahead. Whether it’s ships, weapons, creatures, - as long as he can sell it, he will try to steal it!
After the Borg laid waste to the galaxy, Mudd saw an opening to build his own criminal empire. After all, who was going to stop him? With all the major factions rebuilding and healing, Mudd knows that now was the time to strike. However, with his new ambitions comes more notoriety. And more notoriety means more targets on his back.

name: Honorguard Worf
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: KHITOMER'S REVENGE
FACTION: KLINGON

Lost brother. Found.

Worf, Honorguard to the High Council, and Federation representative to Kronos, has come home. Long gone is the forgotten child of the Empire, replaced by a mighty warrior with unrivalled experience among Starfleet’s finest.

Worf strikes a fine balance between his duty and his bloodline, as he finally sets foot on the bridge of a Klingon battleship. As this iconic hero crosses the gap between his homeworld and his orphan heritage, he becomes ever stronger. Though he does not know with certainty where his future will lure him, he relishes the opportunity to fight alongside his own kind.

name: Hugh
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

Hugh is perhaps the first Borg to have developed his own sense of individuality outside of the Collective. Little is known of Hugh before he became Three of Five. His life began in earnest when he was rescued by the crew of the Enterprise-D and nursed back to health, despite the danger he posed. During his time on the Enterprise he gained a friend, a name and an identity.

Hugh came to understand the reality of assimilation, and the cruelty inherent in robbing an individual of their sense of self, and though he wished to stay with his new friends on the Enterprise, he returned to the Collective in order to protect them.

Hugh’s newfound individuality was something the Collective had never before experienced. It spread like a virus, beginning with the Borg onboard Hugh’s cube. In an attempt to stop its spread, Hugh and his companions were cut off from the Collective and left to fend for themselves.

After his cube was briefly under the control of the infamous Lore, Hugh rose up as leader of the displaced Borg, helping the crew of the Enterprise to put a stop to Lore’s nefarious plans.

Hugh continues to advocate for free Borg and helps to rehabilitate the lucky few who manage to escape Collective, acclimatizing them to the vibrant - but sometimes lonely - life of individuality.

name: Jack Ransom
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: EXPLORER STRIKE TEAM
FACTION: FEDERATION

The role of first officer is widely regarded as one of the most important and revered positions aboard a Starfleet vessel. As second-in-command to their respective captains, many first officers throughout the centuries have become celebrated and, in some cases, legendary figures in the annals of Starfleet history. However, as Commander and first officer of the U.S.S. Cerritos, such a lauded reputation was never on the cards for Jack Ransom.

Ransom prides himself on his natural affinity for diplomacy. He eagerly anticipates opportunities to display his “classic Jack Ransom peace brokering” skills. However, even though he often knows the quickest way to a new civilization’s good side, Ransom has endured frequent brushes with death. Galardonian insects, bloodthirsty Gelrakians and even carnivorous mugatos have all tried and failed to take him down, yet this plucky Commander has always managed to come out the other side in one piece. While on the surface, it would seem that these experiences have strengthened his resolve, Ransom has been noted as displaying an “exaggerated confidence that masks an ocean of insecurity”.

With his fists set to stun, and his kicks set to kill, Commander Ransom is ready to take on anyone or anything that poses a threat to the crew of the U.S.S. Cerritos.

name: Jadzia Dax
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: DS9
FACTION: FEDERATION

Some lessons take a lifetime to learn, so it’s nice to have several lives under your belt before you start learning something new. 
Jadzia Dax is a joined Trill, a fusion of the Dax symbiont and Jadzia, the eighth host of the symbiont and an exceptionally gifted woman whose skills in astrophysics, exoarchaeology, exobiology and zoology earned her distinctions at Starfleet Academy.
As a child, Jadzia was shy and quiet but determined to one day become host to a symbiont, dedicating herself to her studies and applying to the Trill Symbiosis Commission to be a candidate for joining on completion of her studies at the Academy.
Jadzia is the only Trill in history to have successfully reapplied to become a host after her initial request was rejected by Curzon Dax, the seventh Trill to host the Dax symbiont and the good friend and mentor of one Captain Benjamin Sisko.
Friendships that last across different lifetimes are rare for a joined Trill. Personalities change, people become different, so it speaks to the depth of the bond between Dax and Sisko that their friendship remains as strong as ever when Jadzia joins the crew of Deep Space 9, with Sisko still often referring to her affectionately as ‘Old Man’.
As a host, Jadzia contains the memories and experiences of all her predecessors, including an interest in Klingon culture, which impels her to learn Klingon martial arts. It is this aspect of her personality that attracted the attention of Lt. Commander Worf, the Klingon she would eventually fall in love with and marry.
The most fiercely loyal of friends, strong willed, intelligent, and with a wicked sense of humor, Jadzia Dax is the heart and soul of Deep Space 9.

name: James T. Kirk
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: ENTERPRISE CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

James Tiberius Kirk is the Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise, the flagship of the Federation. Kirk was born on January 4th, 2233 aboard a fleeing shuttlecraft during the attack on the U.S.S. Kelvin by the time-traveling Romulan vessel, the Narada.

He joined Starfleet after some persuasion on the part of Captain Christopher Pike and was promoted to First Officer on his first mission aboard. Acting-Captain Spock relinquished command of the U.S.S. Enterprise to Kirk in the aftermath of the destruction of the planet Vulcan. Kirk remains the only Starfleet Cadet to ever "beat" the Kobayashi Maru simulation test at Starfleet Academy.

He was instrumental in the capture of the renegade, Khan, and uncovered a conspiracy by Section 31 operatives to provoke the Klingon Empire into open war.

name: Jason Nesmith
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: GALAXY QUEST
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

Some are destined to walk an unbeaten path, fated to change the course of history forever. Some men are simply born to be heroes.
Jason Nesmith is not one of those men.
Making a name for himself as Peter Quincy Taggart in the cult classic television series, Galaxy Quest, Nesmith found himself quite comfortable in the role, never quite pushing his boundaries, never questioning whether or not he could have a greater career elsewhere.
When the show was canceled after a particularly nail-biting cliffhanger, most of the cast were relieved to finally be free of it. Nesmith, however, never quite recovered from the sting of losing his golden goose. In the years to come, the aging actor held on to whatever scraps of relevancy he could, appearing at conventions, store-openings, and in more than a few car insurance commercials.
However, as his career appeared to hit rock bottom, Nesmith found himself catapulted into a real space adventure. Along with his former castmates, Jason captained the Protector in a battle against the fierce dictator, Sarris. Thanks to his ingenuity, wit, and a good dash of dumb luck, Nesmith managed to defeat the tyrant and save the day.
With his confidence restored and his relationship with his crew stronger, Nesmith returned to his role as Commander Taggart in a revitalized Galaxy Quest TV series that promised to be better than ever before...

name: Jaylah
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: JAYLAH
FACTION: NONE

When Jaylah was born, her parents read the markings on her face, hoping to foretell something about their child’s life. Upon her face they read one word: "Fierce". Jaylah is skilled, intelligent and incredibly strong willed. During her first encounter with the Swarm, her family’s ship was destroyed and her father killed by Krall and his men. Jaylah was left stranded on a strange planet with only her wits and skill to depend on. Not only did she survive this ordeal, she was instrumental in the eventual defeat of Krall and the Swarm. Since then, Jaylah has committed herself to studying at Starfleet Academy. Despite her lack of social graces, she has proven herself to be a mechanic and fighter without equal among her fellow students. Her bravery, ferocity and unwavering determination will ensure a bright future wherever it takes her.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: TNG CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

Jean-Luc Picard is the legendary captain of the Federation’s flagship, the U.S.S. Enterprise. His service to Starfleet has been a lifelong pursuit - one fuelled by a fascination for what lies out beyond the final frontier of space. Picard’s first command was the U.S.S. Stargazer, a ship that saw countless missions and battles over the years.

Aside from his duties as captain, Picard is an avid enthusiast of archaeology, history, the written arts, and diplomacy. His extensive experience on the front lines of many disputes has given him a formidable reputation both within and outside the Federation.

Picard has been directly involved with many key flashpoints of human history during his career. Picard has survived innumerable life-threatening situations, thanks to his own ingenuity, but also the trust he places in his fine crew.

name: Jirali
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: EMERALD CHAIN
FACTION: NONE

With a father who left his family to become a Starfleet engineer and a mother who is a high-ranking officer in the Emerald Chain, Jirali has always been torn between two words. Though her father's absence left her with feelings of abandonment and resentment, she nevertheless spent her childhood dreaming of following in his footsteps. These dreams were cruelly shattered when her father and his crew were attacked by the Borg Collective. 

In the years since, Jirali's already fraught relationship with her mother has eroded further as Jirali's interest - obsession - with the Borg has grown. No one in the Emerald Chain knows as much about Borg technology, or engineering, for that matter. Her expertise has made her a hot commodity, a pliers for hire that plays by her own rules. And though she would never admit it, she still holds out hope that she will one day see her father again, save him from his fate as a Borg drone, and reunite her fractured family for good.

name: Jonathan Archer
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: ENTERPRISE NX-01
FACTION: FEDERATION

Looking back through the annals of Starfleet history, it's clear to see that the name "Archer" has become synonymous with interstellar travel. In the early 22nd century, Dr. Henry Archer worked closely with the renowned Dr. Zefram Cochrane in order to develop the first warp five engine as part of Starfleet's NX Program. Dr. Archer's participation in this program would lead to the development of the Enterprise NX-01 - the first warp-capable starship to bear this distinguished moniker. Although succumbing to the symptoms of advanced Clarke's Disease in 2124, Dr. Archer's work would prove vital in forging humanity's path to the stars and beyond. By eventually stepping up and taking command of Starfleet's first interstellar starship, Jonathan Archer would later choose to navigate this path to the stars in reverence of his father's accomplishments.

During his time as captain of the first Enterprise, Archer was responsible for making first-contact with a number of notable species in both the Alpha and Beta Quadrants. As a result of the diligent work of both Archer and his crew, United Earth's reputation among its interstellar neighbors would be lifted, eventually leading to the formation of the United Federation of Planets. With his unbendable faith of the heart and his unbreakable strength of the soul, Archer would inevitably become one of the most revered figures in Federation history.

name: Kang
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: BLOOD & HONOR
FACTION: KLINGON EMPIRE

Kang is seen as a skilled officer in the Klingon military; Starfleet Intelligence believes he will be the next Gorkon. Kang is skilled in both warfare and diplomacy, and keeps himself and his officers to an iron code.

name: Kathryn Janeway
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: VOYAGER
FACTION: FEDERATION

"There are three things to remember about being a starship captain: keep your shirt tucked in, go down with the ship, and never abandon a member of your crew."

Kathryn Janeway was appointed as captain of the Federation starship U.S.S. Voyager in 2371. Her first general order in this new role was to locate a missing Maquis vessel; an undertaking that would cause Voyager to become stranded in the Delta Quadrant, approximately 70,000 lightyears from home. With Voyager’s crew sustaining heavy casualties upon arrival, Janeway faced a seemingly impossible challenge in her first days of captaincy. Regardless, her display of courage and leadership resulted in several Maquis detainees being promoted to active duty onboard Voyager. These appointments would result in the formation of not just a crew, but a family.

In the annals of Starfleet, no other captain has delved further into the depths of space - willingly or otherwise - than Captain Janeway. Voyager’s mission and journey back home would see Janeway become the first Starfleet captain to successfully traverse the Delta Quadrant. Subsequently, she would become one of the most decorated and venerated captains in Starfleet history.

name: Khan Noonien Singh
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: KHAN'S CREW
FACTION: AUGMENTS

Khan Noonien Singh is one of the greatest threats that Starfleet and the U.S.S. Enterprise has ever faced. Khan is a genetically engineered human Augment, a product of the late-20th century Eugenic Wars which saw Earth dominated and almost destroyed.
After being driven from Earth in 1996, Khan and the rest of the surviving Augments drifted through space for almost 300 years. Frozen and unaware, it was by pure chance that they were happened upon by Admiral Marcus of Starfleet. Marcus stole Khan’s identity and wiped away all the memories of his Augment family.
When Khan reclaimed his memories, he killed Admiral Marcus and launched a one-man war on the Federation, only to be defeated by the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Since then, Khan has lain dormant, frozen inside a Starfleet holding facility. Starfleet may think itself safe, but no prison can hold Khan Noonien Singh for long.

name: Kras
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: GLORY IN THE KILL
FACTION: KLINGON EMPIRE

Kras has served in advisory roles for some time now; more a scientist and negotiator than a commander, but a warrior all the same. Behind many of the rising stars in the Klingon forces, Kras has quietly imparted knowledge and experience. Koloth, Kor, and Kang all count Kras as mentor in their early career. Recently, Kras has turned his attention to Klaa and his crew.

name: Liviana Charvanek
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: ROMULAN PATRIOTS
FACTION: ROMULAN STAR EMPIRE

Liviana Charvanek only recently earned her command, but has distinguished herself as a clever and ruthless strategist, and a true daughter of Romulus. While she favors to strike from positions of strength, she has earned the respect of the Klingons by her ability to fight them toe to toe.

name: Mara Dalen
bio:
CLASS: Science
GROUP: FIRST CONTACT MOVIE
FACTION: NONE

Not every member of the Mavericks has been an Independent from the start. Mara Dalen, however, is as Independent as one could be. Born into a family of colony traders, she knew from a young age that life on the fringes is not an easy one, least of all safe. Save money on a security convoy, and you might end up losing every last strip of Latinum to pirates. Forget to pay a tithe to local warlords, and they might raid your home. And if one hopes for help from Starfleet or a different powerful faction, who knows when they'll find time for a small colony in the midst of world-changing events?
To Mara, there was no other option but to step up and protect the people she loved. Uniting with a few friends, she took action, banishing the criminals who terrorized her colony and inspiring her neighbors to do the same. As their influence grew, so did their impact, and soon, Mara Dalen was a name known to every wrongdoer in her sector. People called her a maverick for stepping up when no one else dared and going against the powerful ones who prey on the vulnerable. But for Mara, everyone joining her cause is a force capable of changing the tide and the violent order of things, and together, they are the Mavericks that change the world for the better.

name: Masriad Vael
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: SYMBIOSIS
FACTION: NONE

Masriad Vael is unlike any other Trill in the Alpha Quadrant, for even though her host body is from our universe, the Symbiont inside her is from the Mirror Universe. Their unique joining makes them especially sensitive to fluctuations in the barriers between dimensions, and allows them to see into the Mirror Universe during special dream states.

Masriad is the latest in a line of Prime Universe Trill to host the Mirror Vael Symbiont, which fell through the dimensions over 300 years ago. Vael has seen and remembers a great many things over their multiple lifetimes, yet even after three centuries, Vael still finds it hard to be fully of this universe. The Mirror at her core still itches at the difference; it knows it is out of place. To that end, Vael almost always surrounds whichever self they happen to be with misfits or eccentrics.

In her current body, the sharp-witted and adventurous Masriad Vael captains a diverse, rogue crew of Independent treasure hunters operating, for the most part, on the edges of the law as they “liberate” some of the galaxy’s rarest and most valuable items from the galaxy’s most undeserving. In that role, Masriad Vael has earned a reputation as one of the most respected and skilled operators in the galaxy.

name: Mavery
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: SYNDICATE
FACTION: NONE

Mavery is an Orion who once retained an influential position in the Syndicate as the right-hand man of one Underboss Arkhel. A naturally-skilled prospector, Mavery oversaw much of the Syndicate’s acquisition of consumable resources - either through legitimate means or otherwise. However, it would not be long until Mavery set his sights on higher profits...

Branching into kidnapping and extortion, Mavery soon recognized that the lode of suffering was the richest vein of all. Once he realized the profits that could be made from such illicit activities, he lost touch with his natural talents, instead focusing on the pursuit of profit through ransom.

As these activities drew more attention from Starfleet towards the Syndicate, Underboss Arkhel came to the troubling realization that his once trusted ally was now nothing more than a liability. While such liabilities would typically be dealt with through more permanent means, Mavery’s service over the years instead influenced Arkhel to exile Mavery from the Syndicate.

Banished to a life of wandering the Alpha Quadrant alone, Mavery soon found acceptance on Shen Dura and a place among the Tal’lah-Hed - a tribalistic criminal organization composed almost exclusively of dissidents and exiled offenders from across the galaxy. Embracing his new-found home, Mavery soon fought his way to the role of “Dah” - supreme leader of the Tal’lah-Hed; a role open to those who would dare stake their claim.

name: Michael Burnham
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: DISCOVERY CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

Once meant to stand as the living embodiment of Human and Vulcan potential, Michael Burnham’s life took a disastrous turn after the Battle at the Binary Stars. Branded a mutineer and sentenced to imprisonment for life, she had given up all hope of living up to her incredible potential.
However, the war was not finished and Burnham still had a part to play. She was brought aboard the U.S.S. Discovery to serve under Captain Gabriel Lorca. She would pay off her debt to society by helping him win the war against the Klingons.
Lorca gave her the greatest gift she ever could have received... Something to fight for. Michael has come to see the Discovery’s crew as her own family and will stop at nothing to defend them.

name: Mirror Kira
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: MIRROR UNIVERSE
FACTION: TERRAN EMPIRE

One of the foremost identifying markers of the alternate dimension was that it was observed to be fundamentally populated by those who were morally antithetical to their Prime equivalents. Perhaps there existed no greater ethical divide than the one separating Kira Nerys from her otherworldly counterpart. While Major Kira Nerys of Deep Space Nine was regarded as a benevolent figurehead and trusted leader, Intendant Kira Nerys of Terok Nor was ultimately reviled by those who suffered under her supervision. With no United Federation of Planets to take charge of the station, the Terok Nor of the alternate dimension instead became a mining facility focused on the processing of uridium ore. Manned almost exclusively by Terran slaves, the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance would appoint some of their most feared officers to instill control over the station’s workers. As Intendant of Terok Nor, Kira would rule through fear and make examples of those who would dare defy her.

A sadistic hedonist, Intendant Kira spent much of her time aboard Terok Nor seeking to satiate her baser desires, often at the expense or suffering of others. Although a vocal proponent of peaceful coercion, Kira was prone to inflicting contradictory bouts of extreme violence, torture and even executions on the Terran slaves who were held on Terok Nor. These behaviors would reinforce Kira’s reputation as one of the most feared Intendants of the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance. However, Kira’s actions would eventually incite resistance among the Terran people. Following her failures to quash the burgeoning rebellion, Kira was forced to retreat into the shadows, hunted not only by those who suffered by her hand, but also by the Alliance to whom she once swore loyalty.

For a time, the name Kira Nerys was nothing more than a memory. However, some memories are not so easily forgotten. After re-emerging from the shadows armed with classified Alliance military intel, Kira was able to use her cunning and guile to shift the balance of power in the alternate dimension and kickstart a glorious resurgence of the Terran Empire. Bewitched by the very figurehead who ruled Terok Nor with an iron fist, the Terran people would instead come to worship and revere this Bajoran who single-handedly revitalized an Empire... All according to her meticulously crafted plans. If she could not be feared as an Intendant, then she would be adored as an Empress.

name: Mirror Picard
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: MIRROR UNIVERSE
FACTION: TERRAN EMPIRE

Although retaining a storied history as one of the most supreme powers in their galaxy, the Terran Empire’s dominance over the alternate universe has been questioned - and even threatened - on several occasions. Throughout the centuries, there have been prolonged periods of flux and uncertainty as the balance of power frequently shifted between the Empire and other dangerous factions. However, even at their lowest points, the Empire remained home to some of the most fearsome, bloodthirsty warriors the galaxy had to offer. Noteworthy among them was Captain Jean-Luc Picard, a name that was both feared and revered in equal measure.

As captain of the crumbling I.S.S. Stargazer, Picard remained a force to be reckoned with among the ranks of the dwindling Empire. Even though his ship had seen better days, Picard was frequently capable of commanding both ship and crew in order to obtain the upper hand in battle with any given adversary. Later, a routine mission to Mars would reveal a project that the Empire had been working on in secret - a new Galaxy-class vessel that would become a jewel in the Empire’s fleet. Finding himself mysteriously drawn to this new ship, as if fate itself was guiding him, Picard would stop at nothing until the captain’s chair of the I.S.S. Enterprise-D was his and his alone.

When Intendant Kira Nerys re-emerged from the shadows and used her classified Alliance intel to once again shift the balance of power in favor of the Empire, the Terrans would enter a new age of power and prosperity. With her appointment as head of state, the new Terran Empress would accept nothing less than the unflinching love and loyalty of her new subjects - a price that Picard and his crew were unwilling to pay as they refused to bow down to a Bajoran leader. As punishment, they would be banished and routed from their homeland, with the I.S.S. Enterprise-D cast into a wormhole to be discarded and forgotten. Although death seemed to be a certainty, the wormhole was in fact an interphasic rift, acting as a gateway to a parallel universe. Rather than the cold embrace of death, Picard and the crew of the I.S.S. Enterprise-D have instead found themselves lost and adrift in a strange, new world...

name: Mirror Uhura
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: MIRROR UNIVERSE
FACTION: TERRAN EMPIRE

Rightful Empress of Terra? Perhaps. Master manipulator? Certainly. Nyota Uhura is as vengeful and power-hungry as the most ruthless of Terrans, though she is adept at hiding her sharp teeth behind a sweet smile. Like her Kelvin counterpart, she serves as a communications officer on the I.S.S. Enterprise. But that is where the similarities end. 

Uhura believes in taking what she wants when she wants it. She does not, however, believe in gratuitous violence. She prefers to wield her power quietly. There is no need for daggers when she can simply blackmail those who stand against her.

It is perhaps surprising, then, that Uhura has invested in the Arena; she would never lower herself to actually participate in the gladiatorial games. Why should she get her hands dirty battling with and against the masses? Instead, she is a silent partner in this burgeoning enterprise. It is a solid investment, after all, and what better way to keep track of the most powerful warriors in her own universe and beyond? There are alliances to be made and secrets to be found out. And Nyota Uhura is the perfect woman for the job.

name: Naga Delvos
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: EMERALD CHAIN
FACTION: NONE

“Peace is a profitable illusion.”

Born to a wealthy family on the Orion homeworld, Naga Delvos was a prodigy. After mastering calculus at age six and forming her first cabal at age twelve, it was clear to all who knew her that she was destined for greatness.
Then came the Emerald Chain.
Formed from the ashes of the old Orion Syndicate, the Emerald Chain rose to power in the wake of the Burn. Establishing a brutal order where there was chaos, they quickly established their dominance over Orion territory.
Naga, knowing what fate awaited criminals under the watchful gaze of the Chain, elected to focus her keen mind on climbing that blood-encrusted ladder instead.
The determined young woman rapidly rose through the ranks, becoming a favored Enforcer of the Chain’s enigmatic leader, Osyraa. Her quick wit, sharp mind, and willingness to shed blood made her an ideal lawbringer.
Still, something stirs in Naga’s heart. The blood of Orion pirates runs through her veins. A renegade’s heart beats in her chest. There may be more destiny left to fulfill for Naga Delvos after all.

name: Nero
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: NERO'S CREW
FACTION: ROMULAN STAR EMPIRE

Nero is a Romulan mining ship Captain who comes from an alternate future. In his timeline's 2387, Nero witnessed the destruction of his homeworld of Romulus.

The untimely efforts of Ambassador Spock to contain the supernova that engulfed his planet resulted in the creation of an artificial black hole, which created this offshoot reality. On arrival, Nero's vessel, the Narada, was heavily damaged in combat with the U.S.S. Kelvin, leaving Nero and his crew stranded.

Nero lost his family when the disaster occurred and on that day, promised himself retribution against Spock for his failure.

name: Nog
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STATUS CONTROL TEAM
FACTION: FERENGI

Born on Ferenginar in the mid-24th century, Nog was the only son of Rom and Prinadora. Following the tumultuous separation of his parents while he was still a lobeling, Nog’s father was forced to raise him alone. Seeking support in this task, Rom reached out to his brother, Quark, for aid. This call for help would prove to be a formative moment in Nog’s life, as it was this arrangement that led him to a permanent residence on the space station Terok Nor. The station would later become known as Deep Space Nine following the withdrawal of the Cardassian contingent at the conclusion of the Occupation of Bajor.

As the Cardassians withdrew from Deep Space Nine, and stewardship of the station was handed over to Starfleet, Nog would soon be introduced to Jake Sisko, son of commanding officer Benjamin Sisko. The pair would quickly become the best of friends, forming a deep bond that would endure throughout the years. Nog’s friendship with Jake and subsequent introduction to the dynamics of a family overseen by a Starfleet officer would prove incredibly influential in Nog’s development, and would directly contribute to the discovery of his deepest ambitions.

For the majority of Ferengi males, the pursuit of profit is an irresistible calling that must be answered upon reaching maturity. However, from an early age, Nog would demonstrate a lack of the typical business acumen expected of a Ferengi entrepreneur. Bereft of a natural instinct for trade and commerce, Nog would instead be forced to rely on his other latent talents. Endowed with the hands of his father and the tenacity of his uncle, Nog’s goals and ambitions would instead lead him down another path that would eventually see him enlisted as the first Ferengi cadet in Starfleet.

name: Odo
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: DS9
FACTION: FEDERATION

Whether serving aboard Deep Space 9 under the Federation or Terok Nor, as it was known when under the Cardassians, the station’s chief of security Odo stands for one thing above all else: justice. 
Odo is unlike any other individual aboard Deep Space 9. He is a Changeling, capable of shifting his shape to take on the appearance of anything or anyone, although he has never quite been able to master the human face. 
When he was discovered adrift in the Denorios Belt and taken to Bajoran scientists, he wasn’t even recognised as a sentient species, just a fascinating gelatinous specimen. He was subjected to painful experiments until he was able to one day prove his sentience and begin a new existence in his own right.
For a long time, he believed himself to be the only one of his kind, and for a long time after he found out he wasn’t, he may have wished otherwise.
Odo’s people, the Changelings, are the cruel, dictatorial rulers of the Dominion, implacable enemy of all “solid” lifeforms and the aggressors in a bloody war against the Federation and its allies in the Alpha Quadrant.
In the face of all that, Odo keeps his focus squarely concentrated on justice and upholding the law on his station, whether that’s thwarting the mercantile machinations of small-time nemesis Quark or making sure no one can use DS9 as the middle ground for starting a civil war.
Odo’s approach to justice is as pragmatic as they come. It doesn’t matter who is making the laws; all that matters is justice and fairness. He is the quintessential police officer, beholden to the law but capable of nuance and egalitarian in its application. In Odo’s world, no one - no one - is above the law.

name: PIC Admiral Picard
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: PICARD
FACTION: FEDERATION

How much can a man hold on to who he is, to the ideas he holds dear, when all around him the universe he knows and loves seems to be shifting away from him? For Admiral Jean-Luc Picard, a man historically given to existential introspection, a man quite literally no longer the human being he used to be, these questions loom large.

The Federation has been touched by darker days since Jean-Luc captained the Enterprise. The destruction of Romulus, and the events that followed it, not least Starfleet’s response to Romulan suffering, led Picard to resign acrimoniously from Starfleet. Yet, in a time of uncertainty, when the threads of old enmities threaten to fray and snap, when the bloodlust rises and calls for war, perhaps Jean-Luc Picard is the older, wiser head the galaxy needs.

name: PIC Hugh
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: EX-BORG
FACTION: EX-BORG

Life as a Borg drone is long gone for Hugh, but his scars will never heal. Losing a connection to the Collective is not an easy feat. While some manage to recover from this experience, for others, this process and the resulting struggles will hardly ever end. Knowing just how challenging reclaiming one's own life could be, it's no wonder that Hugh, one of the first drones to gain self-consciousness, received the executive director position of the Borg Reclamation Project. With his help, numerous Ex-Borgs gained hope and found support in a world where their kind is treated like hazardous waste or an inanimate workforce.

If there were one word to describe Hugh, it would be loyalty: loyalty to the cause and his friends. During his work at the Borg Reclamation Project, he stood by his fellow Ex-Borgs, protecting them from the opportunistic and ruthless Romulans, and by Captain Picard when he required help in saving the universe once again. Such selflessness doesn't always end well, but in Hugh's case, it means no Ex-Borg will be left behind, and as long as his kind has hopes of a better tomorrow, he will keep fighting for it.

name: PIC RIKER
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: PICARD
FACTION: FEDERATION

If there’s one man in the galaxy who can claim to have been there and seen it all, that man is Captain Will Riker. And through it all, he has managed to hold on to his charm and wry humor. Not bad for a guy who was even briefly bestowed with the power of godhood. 

But some things are harder to take than others. While Riker has come through confrontations with some of the meanest, most dangerous entities in the Alpha Quadrant and beyond, none of that can compare to the heartache of personal loss. For this Riker has felt the death of a son, and the reverberations of that event as they shook through his relationship with the love of his life, Deanna Troi.

Yet still, he remains at core the man he always was. A loyal friend. A man of honor and courage. A man who has seen the evil that lies in the depths of space and can still look back at the universe with a wink. A man who, much like his beloved jazz, can take a note of sadness and weave it into a melody of sublime joy.

name: PIC Worf
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: PICARD
FACTION: FEDERATION

Worf, son of Mogh, of the house of Martok, son of Sergey of House Rozhenko, is not the Klingon he once was. These days, the slayer of Gowron, bane to the Clan of Duras, walks the path of the pacifist. Worf has reached deep inside of himself and learned that even the greatest of warriors must be able to embrace serenity and peace as much as the flames of rage. 

This is a Worf who has searched his soul and come out the other side with a wiser head on his shoulders - not that it stops him from occasionally removing unwiser heads from their shoulders if circumstances demand it.

And circumstances are complicated. Worf is still a part of Starfleet, and still has a job to do. The galaxy faces a threat it had thought long vanquished, a threat that requires the stealth and skills of the Federation’s most celebrated Klingon warrior to neutralize it. But now Worf can face his enemies unencumbered by irrational anger and violence, for now he understands that in the heat of battle, the stance that yields the greatest advantage is to be centered in oneself.

name: Phellun
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: SYNDICATE
FACTION: NONE

These are good days for the Orion Syndicate. Business is good and profits are high. Then again, when you reign over a sector that embraces assassination, slave-trading, smuggling, and piracy, could it be any other way? Still, you can’t just trust circumstances conducive to criminality to deliver; you need good people. Better said, when it comes to the Orion Syndicate, you need bad people, bad people who are good at being bad. And they don’t come any worse, or better, than Phellun.

Phellun is a smooth operator, and he knows it. That’s what makes him so popular with the Syndicate’s most voracious matriarchs. Cool as they come, he’s the go-to green guy when you need the goods to get to the right place at the right time. Phellun delivers. Not just the merchandise, but also quality of service. Any pirates out there thinking of stealing Phellun’s cargo should ask themselves a simple question: how can you pick a pocket when there’s nothing at the end of your wrists? You have to hand it to Phellun, or he might just take your hands away.

name: Phlox
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: ENTERPRISE NX-01
FACTION: FEDERATION

One of the first aliens to serve aboard the Enterprise, Doctor Phlox of Denobula is one of its most beloved, most valuable crew members.
Despite having only six months of service within Starfleet, the good Doctor Phlox was selected to assist the Enterprise in her maiden voyage following a miraculous treatment of a dying Klingon warrior.
Although his patient would eventually be captured by the Suliban, Phlox continued to serve with distinction aboard the Enterprise, proving himself an invaluable member of the crew on numerous occasions.
Even considering his odd propensity of collecting and cataloging odd alien fauna, one could not ask for a better physician, especially if one’s life is on the line.

name: Quark
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: FERENGI CONGLOMERATE
FACTION: FERENGI

A 24th century Ferengi, Quark was born to parents Ishka and Keldar on the planet Ferenginar. Along with his brother, Rom, the siblings enjoyed a typical Ferengi upbringing in many aspects.
