However, Quark would be regularly embarrassed by his mother, and teased by other children for her refusal to adapt to traditional Ferengi customs. This relationship may have played a vital role in Quark’s later desires to leave Ferenginar.

Upon reaching the Age of Ascension, Quark’s desire to seek profit among the stars became too intense to contain. Contrary to the advice of his father, he immediately set out to seek his fortune and his place on the Latinum Stairway. It wasn’t long until he purchased an apprenticeship with the District Sub-Nagus, in accordance with Ferengi By-Laws. Quark immediately shined in this role, and quickly became a “golden boy” of the Sub-Nagus. However, in a moment of weakness, Quark lost everything when he enraged the Sub-Nagus by sleeping with his sister.

Disgraced and tormented by his past failures and the ruination of a lucrative apprenticeship, Quark sought a means to redeem himself while also retaining a mere sliver of success. After some time as a cook aboard a Ferengi freighter, he would finally receive a chance at redemption on board the Cardassian space station Terok Nor. Here, Quark became the proprietor of Quark’s Bar, Grill, Gaming House and Holosuite Arcade - more commonly known as “Quark’s” among its discerning customers. Under his administration, Quark’s became a thriving hub of recreation in the Alpha Quadrant. From the station’s inception as Terok Nor, to its current iteration as Deep Space 9, weary travelers can always depend on the hospitality at Quark’s to help them unwind.

name: Quasi
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: MIRROR UNIVERSE
FACTION: SECTION 31

Chameloids are so rare that their existence has been considered a myth, and that’s no wonder: how does one adequately monitor and study a species that can look like anything? Regardless of their chosen forms, one thing is known for sure - Chameloids exist, and at least one of them can be found within the ranks of Section 31. A talented physicist, Quasi proved the existence of mythical glioclusters and subsequently earned his place on the Alpha Team, who were looking to contact Philippa Georgiou in order to stop a weapon of mass destruction from falling into the hands of the Terran Empire. 
Quasi’s talent in calculating all possible outcomes of any situation is indispensable in his line of work. However, the number of choices to take would trick his mind into a paralysis state, even when the situation is critical. This flaw almost cost Georgiou and Alok's life, but with the help of Rachel Garrett, he took the situation under control and made the only right decision, giving those two a chance. A loyal friend and a lovely person, Quasi serves Section 31 and his friends in all of his shapes and forms and can apply his genius mind for a good cause.

name: Reginald Barclay
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: HOLODECK
FACTION: FEDERATION

Not all are destined to make history. 
Reginald Barclay may be the subject of derision from his crewmates on the Enterprise-D, due to his nervous behavior and reclusive personality, but behind that awkward mask lies the mind of a brilliant engineer.
So great was Barclay’s talents and determination that he managed to overcome a list of fears and complexes to find himself assigned to Starfleet’s flagship. The admiralty saw something in him, and they were not wrong... mostly.
An expert in holographic technology and quantum mechanics, Barclay became synonymous with the ship’s Holodeck. From keeping the crew’s favorite pastime technology ticking, to performing crucial repairs on the flagship’s systems, Barclay consistently proved himself to be an irreplaceable, consistent asset to the crew.

name: Rom
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: FERENGI CONGLOMERATE
FACTION: FERENGI

Often left in the shadow of his more enterprising older brother, Rom has worn many hats out of duty to Quark. Server, pit boss, assistant – he’s done it all. His loyalty to his brother has meant that Rom has always been willing to work hard for the good of Quark’s business endeavors. Despite some reluctance, Rom is still a Ferengi at heart, and is willing to try underhanded tactics for the sake of helping his brother.

Ultimately, due to Rom’s struggle to put profit ahead of his family, and with his talents lying in engineering rather than business, he is something of an outcast among his people. These feelings of isolation, and the imbalanced relationship with Quark, often manifest as jealousy and resentment. Indeed, Rom’s greatest conflict has always been whether to embrace his Ferengi nature, or to become something better for the sake of his son, Nog.

name: Rose Harper
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: VILLAINS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Harper’s record was as pristine as a Chief Security Officer could hope for. She graduated from Starfleet Academy with excellence, proved herself as acting captain of the U.S.S. Exeter during the Battle of Caprell T-9, received various citations and awards -  but everything started to go wrong after she was posted to the U.S.S. Griffin.

Personal logs suggest she suffered from an increasingly dangerous case of paranoia. That would be understandable if the U.S.S. Griffin was on a clandestine mission - after all, she was their Chief Security Officer. But it wasn’t. Less understandable is the idea that someone sworn to protect her crew would instead kill them in cold blood. 

Harper made no attempt to hide her crimes: strangulation, stabbing, ejecting personnel into open space without EV-suits, all to protect herself from... from what? 

Not the crew. They were the ones in danger. 

Nor an alien intrusion or environmental hazard. A subsequent investigation of the U.S.S. Griffin found no signs of either. 

The recordings are becoming increasingly erratic. Harper is looking through the screen now. She is searching for someone. Her gaze, glassy, yet piercing...

No. You must be imagining things. 
The screens were offline the entire time.

name: S31 Georgiou
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: SECTION 31

The storied life of Emperor Philippa Georgiou has retained many twists and turns along the way. From her humble childhood spent getting by on the outskirts of the Terran Empire to claiming the Imperial throne itself, only to abdicate it for a new life in a parallel universe, Georgiou is quite the enigma. Yet, despite everything she's gone through, Philippa remains one of the most dangerous, cunning, and ambiguous people in both realms. It comes as no wonder that Section 31 needed her help and would subsequently recruit her repeatedly for their most daring and critical missions to protect the Federation.
After traveling to the 32nd century with the Discovery crew, Georgiou experienced an unprecedented deteriorating condition caused by traversing through great lengths of space and time. Forced to leave her newfound crew behind in order to save her life, she made her way back into the 24th century with the help of the Guardian of Forever, where another chapter in the story of Philippa Georgiou could begin. 
Taking control of the Baraam under the guise of the enigmatic Madame Veronique du Franc, she established a booming entertainment venue, attracting all sorts of clientele and inadvertently providing Section 31 with a base of operations well beyond the borders allowed by the Treaty of Ka'Tann. Her unique set of skills and the strategically advantageous location of her new business venture played a critical role in defending the Prime Universe from the invasion of the Terran Empire. Now, regardless of the journey that brought her here, Georgiou is ready for her new life as a Section 31 agent and all the adventures it will bring.

name: SNW Black Ops M'Benga
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Unusually for the Chief Medical Officer aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, Joseph M’Benga is not just a physician, but someone intimately familiar with violence. He fought hand-to-hand on the front lines during the Federation-Klingon War, and has a secretive past as a Starfleet special forces operative known as “the Ghost.” In particular, he played a key role in the infamous Battle of J’Gal, where he used his self-developed combat drug, Protocol 12, to single-handedly kill the Klingon battle commanders. Although General Dak’Rah, known as the “Butcher of J’Gal” for reportedly slaying his own commanders, managed to escape.

Later, M’Benga met Dak’Rah aboard the Enterprise, at a time when the Klingon was now a celebrated ambassador. The two exchanged heated words, M’Benga unhappy that Dak’Rah had built a career as a peacemaker, off the back of the blood on M’Benga’s own hands - since he had been the true Butcher of J’Gal. They fought in sickbay, and M’Benga’s Klingon knife, which he’d also used to slay the commanders on J’Gal, found its way into Dak’Rah’s chest. He died on the spot. Although the instigator of the fight was unclear, as was how the knife wound up in Dak’Rah’s chest, M’Benga’s loyal friend and staff member, Nurse Chapel, claimed to have witnessed the whole thing, and vouched for his innocence.

This exemplifies how M’Benga’s medical expertise, combined with his military experience, makes him a valuable, if unorthodox asset, as the Enterprise continues to boldly go into an uncertain future.

name: SNW Christopher Pike
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

For Christopher Pike, the right to walk the path to the captain’s chair of the U.S.S. Enterprise was to be earned, not granted. Nonetheless, it was a path he walked with dignity, valor and exemplary skill. It would take active service on board a number of different Federation starships before Pike would find himself assigned to the bridge of the Enterprise. Following a brief tenure serving under the command of Captain Robert April as his first officer, Pike was given command of the ship in the year 2250. By the time Ensign Spock arrived on board the Enterprise in 2254, Captain Pike was widely regarded as one of the most heavily decorated fighting captains in Starfleet history.

However, even the bravest and the boldest have their demons. Although he continues to be haunted by nightmarish portents of a seemingly inevitable fate, this celebrated serviceman has decided to claim a destiny of his own by answering the call of the stars. With a stalwart crew and one of Starfleet’s flagship vessels under his command, Captain Pike is once again prepared to seek out new life and explore strange new worlds.

name: SNW D'Chok
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: KLINGON

Captain D’Chok is one of Spock’s oldest friends. They first met during a diplomatic incident between Starfleet and the Klingon Defense Force, at the Dilithium mining planet of Cajitar IV. A rogue syndicate known as the Broken Circle tried to restart the Klingon War for personal gain, via a false flag attack on D’Chok’s vessel. Spock prevented the attack by destroying the false Federation starship. When D’Chok questioned his motivations, Spock suggested they open a barrel of bloodwine to conclude their discussion and show that he could be trusted. D’Chok was impressed at this suggestion from a Vulcan, and was eager to see the results in person. 

Since then, D’Chok has continued to excel in the Klingon military, being particularly noted for his genial personality and diplomatic qualities - especially towards non-Klingons. It is surely only a matter of time before Chancellor L’Rell promotes him to the rank of General.

name: SNW Hemmer
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Hemmer arrived on the decks of the U.S.S. Enterprise in the year 2259, replacing the once-doting Louvier as the ship’s chief engineer. Although blind like many of his Aenar counterparts, Hemmer refuses to accept this trait as a hindrance, instead relying on sight granted through telepathy. He will actively refute any offers of help or assistance that would imply him to be at a physical disadvantage to his fellow crew members.

It wasn’t long before Hemmer was presented with an opportunity to prove his worth as chief engineer. His work in the field of photon torpedo retrofitting was integral in altering the course of the comet C/2260-Quentin, which was on a collision course with the planet Persephone III. This cataclysmic event would have likely led to the destruction of all life on the planet. However, thanks to Hemmer and the crew of the Enterprise, this fate would not come to pass.

name: SNW James Kirk
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Brash, confident, self-assured yet empathetic, James Tiberius Kirk is not only the First Officer aboard the U.S.S. Farragut, but he is also the all-time youngest serving first officer in the history of Starfleet, even beating his father, the previous owner of that auspicious record. 

Such a rapid ascension is no surprise to anyone who knows him. Kirk is driven, ambitious, ready to take risks when the moment is right, and as he put it himself, he is more than willing to “put in some legwork” to get what he wants.

Captain Pike of the U.S.S. Enterprise sees great potential in Kirk after watching him lead the Farragut in an alternative timeline. The two officers cross paths more often as Kirk’s duties bring him into contact with Pike’s ship and crew. 

Also aboard the Enterprise is Kirk’s brother Sam. Their relationship borders on antagonistic, but that’s family sometimes, which is prophetic since some of the other people James Kirk encounters aboard Pike’s ship will one day become his chosen family. But that day is a long way off yet...

name: SNW M'Benga
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Kenyan-born Doctor Joseph M’Benga is the Chief Medical Officer aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. One of Starfleet’s most skilled physicians, M’Benga’s knowledge encompasses much of the Federation. He has particular expertise with Vulcan biology, having conducted his medical internship on Vulcan itself.

Yet for all his skill, M’Benga was unable to cure his daughter Rukiya of a terrible illness, storing her instead in the transporter buffers of the Enterprise until a cure could be found. Ultimately, her only chance was to stay behind with an alien entity as a being of pure consciousness. A fate better than death, to be sure.

And M’Benga has seen more than his fair share of death, meting it out himself as a Starfleet special operative known as the Ghost and serving on the front lines during the Klingon War. While outwardly, he appears measured and mild-mannered, beneath the surface beats the heart of a fierce fighter, a man who has experienced tragedy and come out the other side marked but intact, the embodiment of quiet strength.

name: SNW Montgomery Scott
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Montgomery Scott, known to his friends as “Scotty,” and to Commander Pelia as “that pain in my backside that could have done so much better at the Academy, but is surprisingly adept in a pinch,” is an extremely promising young Starfleet engineer.

Already experienced from serving on various starships and freighters, Scott found himself stationed aboard the U.S.S. Stardiver when it was attacked and destroyed by the Gorn in the Shangdi system. His ingenuity led to him being the sole survivor, and he later assisted the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise in their battle against the Gorn on Parnassus Beta.

Reunited with his old Academy professor, and Chief Engineer of the Enterprise, Commander Pelia, she has taken him under her extensive wing, sharing teachings and insights from her long lifetime - amidst a few choice insults - to help him maximize his potential. Recently promoted to a full Lieutenant, and noted for his ability to work engineering miracles, Scotty’s future would appear to be very bright indeed.

name: SNW Sam Kirk
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

George Samuel “Sam” Kirk is a scientist - a xenoanthropologist and research biologist - who serves as a lieutenant, junior grade, aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, where he is a member of the life sciences department under Lieutenant Spock.

Like everyone, he has his issues. Having a well-respected father and a precocious, accomplished younger brother racing ahead of you isn't easy. Sure, sometimes, Sam - known to “absolutely no one” as George - might let himself feel morose and bitter about it, but for the most part, he’s a happy, reliable, stand-up guy everybody likes. Everybody except half-human, half-Vulcan officers going through a thing.

But Sam is self-aware enough to know himself and strong enough to want to do better when he feels like he’s fallen short. He once found himself threatened by the Gorn on a crashed ship, and his reaction at the time wasn’t one he was proud of. So the next time he had the chance to face the Gorn, he volunteered, eager to put things right, which proves one thing above all others. He may not be his father. He may not be his brother. But he is most definitely a Kirk.

name: SNW T'Pring
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

T’Pring was arranged to marry Spock from a young age, but it was only in adulthood that the pair formalized their engagement, after Spock returned to Vulcan. However, T’Pring had to be content with a long-distance relationship, as Spock could not ultimately forego his duties aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Nor did she wish to give up her responsibilities as an agent of the El-Keshtanktil, working to help Vulcan criminals purge the emotions that had led them to commit their crimes. Yet they still found time to be together, usually when T’Pring visited Spock aboard the Enterprise or at a starbase - including one memorable occasion when a Vulcan ritual caused them to exchange bodies with one another!

Unbeknownst to T’Pring, Spock and Nurse Chapel had developed feelings for one another and had an affair aboard the Enterprise, with Spock growing more distant. Things came to a head during their engagement dinner when, despite Spock eventually managing to impress T’Pring’s parents, she discovered he’d been hiding that he’d temporarily become human. Offended he would keep this from her, she decided they should spend some time apart - though it is surely only a matter of time until they are reunited.

name: SNW Una Chin-Riley
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Una Chin-Riley started her career with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, when she was assigned to the U.S.S. Martin Luther King Jr. as an Ensign. It was during Una’s time serving on this vessel that she encountered and rescued La’an Noonien-Singh from Gorn captivity. Inspired by Una’s actions, La’an would later join Starfleet herself. By the mid 2250’s, Una was serving aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise as helmsman and first officer to Captain Christopher Pike. Una would soon earn the moniker of “Number One”, a name she would diligently carry in service and representation of her ship and fellow crew.

By the end of the 2250’s, Number One had been fully promoted to the rank of Commander, and was assigned to command the crew of the U.S.S. Archer. The Archer’s mission was to make first contact with the inhabitants of Kiley 279 after the potential detection of a warp drive on the planet’s surface. However, when first contact with the inhabitants of the planet went awry, Number One was taken hostage along with other members of the Archer’s crew. After a successful rescue mission conducted by Captain Pike and his away team, Number One returned to her post as first officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Sela
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: PRIDE OF ROMULUS
FACTION: ROMULAN

Commander Sela is an officer of the Romulan Military, and the half-human daughter of Starfleet’s Tasha Yar. Sela’s desire to integrate into the ranks of Romulan society have been compromised by her heritage, which has been viewed as an inherent disadvantage by her peers. This has given Sela a vicious streak, as she has had to fight extra hard for every scrap of renown and respect that she has earned throughout the years.

Sela’s devotion to the ideals of the Romulan Senate are absolute, and she rejects the human half of her lineage completely. Her role amongst the Romulan military has been to specialize in disrupting any sign of peace or alliance between the Klingon Empire and the Federation. Her methods are extreme, and Sela displays no sign of compassion or remorse in her pursuit of glory for the Romulan Star Empire.

name: Seska
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: VOYAGER 30TH ANNIVERSARY
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

How far would you go to save your own life?
Trapped thousands of light years from home and faced with a future of endless wandering of the stars, Seska made a decision. She would do what no one else aboard Voyager had the courage to do.
She would save her own life.
Seska betrayed her fellow crew members, acting as a spy for the Cardassians under the promise of an imminent return to Earth. Of course, their promise of salvation was fictitious, but desperate people are willing to believe almost anything.
Seska proved herself as a cunning, dedicated operative, successfully hiding her true intentions from her crew for some time before she was eventually exposed as a traitor.

name: Seven of Nine
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: VOYAGER
FACTION: FEDERATION

Of all the wonders encountered by the U.S.S. Voyager on its journey home through the Delta Quadrant, perhaps none are as surprising and endlessly fascinating as Seven of Nine. When the crew first met Seven, she was still a fully augmented Borg, very much a part of the Collective. However, when her link to the Borg was severed and the majority of her implants removed, Seven was given a place aboard the Starfleet vessel. There, under the mentorship of Captain Janeway, she began the journey to reclaim that which the Borg had taken from her so long ago: her individuality.

That journey is not an easy one. Seven was assimilated when she was just six years old, when she was still Annika, daughter of Magnus and Erin Hansen. They were exobiologists investigating the Borg, tracking their movements and gathering data, oblivious to the danger they were putting themselves in until they were captured, and Annika’s transformation into Seven was begun.

Free to be herself again, Seven dedicates her mind to self-actualization and her skills and knowledge to the good of Voyager. But when you have been a Borg for as long as Seven, things like the niceties of social interaction are difficult. She often comes across as cold and logical, causing friction and misunderstanding with the crew, but regardless of the wall of studied dispassion she has erected, underneath, Seven is as human as they come: insecure, vulnerable and desperate to belong.

name: Shaxs
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: BATTLESHIP STRIKE TEAM
FACTION: FEDERATION

In the early 24th century, the Bajoran Occupational Government was formed by the Cardassian Union - an assertion of control over the people of Bajor that would lead to more than half a century of strife and conflict. During this time, the Bajoran Resistance was formed as a direct response to the Cardassian occupation of Bajor, with men and women from all walks of life standing together in defiance of their oppressors. Possessing a keen sense of morality from an early age, as well as a festering hatred for all things Cardassian, Shaxs joined the Resistance as soon as he was old enough to enlist. Even though the Resistance proved successful in overthrowing the Cardassian occupation, this victory came at a cost, leaving Shaxs a deeply scarred man. Even today, the slightest mention of Bajor or the Cardassians can send him into a blind rage. In fact, it’s probably better just to not mention those things if he’s in earshot.

Shortly after the dissolution of the Bajoran Occupational Government, a wayward Shaxs enlisted in Starfleet. A strong and courageous officer, he was swiftly promoted to Lieutenant and assigned as security chief of the U.S.S. Cerritos. Although often capable of being perceived as short-tempered, Shaxs remained deeply protective of his fellow crew members. Even though his gritted teeth and furrowed brow could be deterring to some, Shaxs was capable of demonstrating warmth, often referring to Ensigns Rutherford and Boimler affectionately as his "Baby Bears." His loyalty and diligence to his crew would ultimately lead Shaxs to sacrifice his own life in order to save the life of Ensign Rutherford. However, after his very soul had endured a multitude of battles in the otherworldly Bajoran black mountain, Shaxs was resurrected and returned to his duties. Not even death itself could keep this Bajoran down. Because after all, fighting fascism is a full-time job.

name: Six of Eleven
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

One of the first Klingons to experience the Borg’s invasion of the Alpha Quadrant, Kras fell prey to an assimilation fleet while overseeing a routine mining expedition. Although Kras was a skilled warrior, he was unfamiliar with this formidable new enemy, and his simple mining fleet was swiftly overwhelmed by Borg forces. Kras once served an important advisory role among the Klingon Empire. Now, he speaks on behalf of the Borg, imparting their message - All will be assimilated, and resistance is futile.

name: Soran
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: EXPLORER RETALIATION SQUAD
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

Dr. Tolian Soran was an El-Aurian scientist born in the late 21st century. His formative years living on the El-Aurian homeworld were idyllic, with Soran enjoying all of the comforts and luxuries of a successful, family-oriented life. Along with his wife, Leandra, Soran would become the proud parent of several children whom he loved dearly. However, Soran's halcyon days would come to an abrupt end in the 23rd century when the El-Aurian homeworld was invaded by the Borg Collective. Although he escaped the onslaught, Soran's family was lost during the invasion. The trauma of this loss transformed Soran from a loving husband and father into a twisted, bitter nihilist who believed that the only universal constant was one that all living beings eventually encounter - death itself. 

In the years following the assimilation and destruction of the El-Aurians, Soran was one of the 415 El-Aurian refugees traveling to Earth onboard the fleet comprised of the SS Lakul and SS Robert Fox, when both transport ships became trapped in the celestial doorway of the Nexus. Although both transport vessels were eventually destroyed, 47 survivors were rescued by the U.S.S. Enterprise-B, with Soran among them. As the Nexus was a realm shaped by the desires and needs of those who entered it, many survivors expressed an intense desire to return to the Nexus. While their Federation rescuers tried to calm them, none of the survivors expressed such an intense desire to return to the Nexus as Soran did. Knowing that the Nexus was the only way for him to be reunited with his family, Soran's compulsion to return to this extra-dimensional realm would become all-consuming. He would focus the remainder of his life's work on attempting to return to the Nexus permanently.

Soran's master plan to return to the Nexus involved the acquisition and deployment of a Trilithium weapon. This devastating artillery was intended to destroy a number of stars and, through the alteration of gravitational forces due to the stars' destruction, would force the doorway of the Nexus to wash over the planet Veridian III. Here, Soran would be waiting patiently, assured that he would return to the Nexus once again. It would take the combined efforts of Starfleet captains James T. Kirk and Jean-Luc Picard to put a stop to Soran's plan, with both Soran and Kirk losing their lives in the conflict. Although he never managed to return to the Nexus, Soran would instead be reunited in death with the family he longed to be with once again.

name: Specialist Seven
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: BATTLESHIP RETALIATION SQUAD
FACTION: FEDERATION

Not all wounds heal with time.
Getting home was the mission. The mission was completed. Why, then, did Seven of Nine still feel empty?
Despite her best efforts, Seven was never fully able to integrate into civilian life on Earth. The idea of being static was alien to her, the concept of comfort a far-gone dream. She felt as if she would sink into her too-soft bed at any time and be delivered back to the Borg.
Seven hoped that a career in Starfleet would ease her discomfort and provide a sense of meaning to her life again. However, Federation bureaucracies proved too insurmountable a wall, and she was denied entry to Starfleet Academy.
Not content to wallow away in the utopian cities of Earth, Seven struck out on her own, eager to find a path that was hers alone to tread.
She found herself drawn to the darker corners of the quadrant, far from the safety of the Federation. Seven was most at home in the Neutral Zone, where she struck up friendships among the other wayward souls and Independent operators that didn’t fit in with Federation policies. There were good people out here, Seven realized, good people who needed protection that Starfleet couldn’t provide.
Word soon began to spread across the Neutral Zone of a partially cybernetic guardian, a fierce protector who fought with the fury of a thousand suns to protect her territory.
So hear this warning, pirates and slavers of the quadrant, keep a keen eye for the symbol of the Hound of Yoruba, for if you see her ship approaching first... It is already too late.

name: Starfleet Q
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: INTERCEPTOR RETALIATION SQUAD
FACTION: Q

In the year 2364, under the command of Captain Jean-Luc Picard, the U.S.S. Enterprise-D embarked on its maiden voyage to Deneb IV. Its mission was to make contact with a species known as the Bandi and investigate the expedited construction of Farpoint Station. However, en route to Deneb IV, Captain Picard and his crew would encounter a being unlike any other - the omnipotent Q. Hailing from an extra-dimensional realm known as the Q Continuum, Q took it upon himself to place humanity as a whole on trial for alleged savagery and barbarism throughout their history. While Captain Picard was successful in his defense of humanity's history and standing among their galactic peers, Q would find himself personally fascinated with Picard, and the two would go on to develop a complicated and storied relationship with one another.

Over the subsequent years, Q would continue to appear without notice to unsuspecting Starfleet crews and captains, ready to test their moral ethics and question humanity's place in the galaxy. While capable of adopting any external appearance that he saw fit, Q would frequently apparate on the bridge of a Starfleet vessel in the form of a male humanoid donned in full captain's uniform. Although his motivations for doing so were questionable, and could be easily mistaken for stolen valor, this mockery was nothing more than an attempt to unsettle the Starfleet captain unfortunate enough to find Q on their bridge.

name: Strike Team SNW La'an
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: FEDERATION

La’an Noonien-Singh is the Chief of Security aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Her dedication to her ship and crew is unparalleled. She takes pride in her physical prowess and runs a series of drills and classes in self-defense and advanced combat training with every member of the crew. La’an leads away teams to dangerous locations regularly, and relies on her attuned sense for survival. La’an is the sole survivor of a brutal Gorn attack on her home colony, and carries the tortured memories of that time with her every day.

Regardless of her Augment heritage, or perhaps in spite of it, La’an remains staunchly opposed to all facets of genetic engineering. However, being a descendant of the great Khan will forever link her name to these practices. Realizing that one will never be able to escape the bonds of their heritage, La’an has instead decided to stop running and establish an identity of her own.

name: TMP Hikaru Sulu
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: THE MOTION PICTURES
FACTION: FEDERATION

Once helmsman of the U.S.S. Enterprise, now Captain of the U.S.S. Excelsior, Hikaru Sulu cuts a sharp figure and even sharper wit, in pursuit of upholding the Federation’s noblest ideals. A recent accomplishment was assisting Captain Kirk and the Enterprise-A in defeating General Chang, bringing about a once-unthinkable peace with the Klingon Empire at Camp Khitomer.

Fond of hot tea, Sulu is a warm and approachable confidante for his crew, helping to steer the early Starfleet career of one Ensign Tuvok, who served aboard the Excelsior as a junior science officer. He also appointed Commander Janice Rand as his communications officer, having served with her aboard both the Enterprise and Enterprise-A. But once the alert condition turns red, Sulu transforms into the fine tactician demanded of his station, adopting a controlled and disciplined approach that speaks to his other loves: fencing, judo, aikido, and botany (perhaps explaining his love of tea). With a flair for the dramatic, he inspires his crew to rise to the occasion of whatever challenge lies before them, be that cataloguing gaseous anomalies, or racing to the aid of the Enterprise against General Chang.

As well as being a Starfleet career veteran, Sulu also found time to start a family. His daughter, Demora, followed in his footsteps, attending Starfleet Academy and earning her own place as the helmsman of the Enterprise-B, when it launched in 2293.

name: TMP Nyota Uhura
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: THE MOTION PICTURES
FACTION: FEDERATION

Famous communications officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise, Nyota Uhura has had a long and illustrious Starfleet career, from her peerless Academy days, to multiple five-year missions aboard the Enterprise, under both Captains Pike and Kirk. Despite her initial reservations about such a career, doubting that she was good enough, she ultimately embraced the journey and boldly followed in her grandmother’s footsteps.

Few, if any, Starfleet officers possess Uhura’s level of skill and excellence in both linguistics and exolinguistics. She not only deploys this practically as a communications officer, but also commands great diplomatic power, given her intimate knowledge of the languages and cultures of the galaxy.

She is also a master of modern and legacy communications protocols and technologies. Indeed, she was able to retrieve 20th-century NASA transmission codes aboard the Enterprise, which were integral to communication with the V’ger entity, when it assailed the Solar System. On another occasion, she visited 20th-century Earth herself, aboard a commandeered Klingon Bird-of-Prey, and proved that her communications expertise even extended to whale song!

No stranger to promotion, she has recently been elevated to the rank of captain, though she is yet to receive her first command. Thus, despite the recent decommissioning of the U.S.S. Enterprise-A, a message relayed to the bridge crew by Uhura herself, her career is certainly not winding down. In fact, she is just getting started.

name: TOS James T. Kirk
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: TOS ENTERPRISE CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

Explorer. Diplomat. Hero. 
James Tiberius Kirk has been called many things, but most just call him... Captain.
Born in Iowa on Earth in 2233, Kirk was raised by his loving parents; George and Winona Kirk. Their teachings, in particular those of his father, inspired a young Kirk to enlist in Starfleet.
Though he had some blemishes on his record from certain events in the Academy, Kirk proved himself as a reliable man with a noble spirit.
Kirk was a natural leader and quickly climbed the ranks as a Starfleet officer. After a tour of duty aboard the U.S.S. Farragut, Kirk found himself assigned to Starfleet’s most prolific vessel; The U.S.S. Enterprise. In 2265, at the age of thirty-two, Kirk was granted command of the Enterprise from Captain Pike. It was the proudest day of his father’s life.
Kirk went on to serve with distinction. Under his steadfast leadership, the Enterprise has survived wars, natural disasters, time travel and near galactic destruction. They became legends.
Throughout it all, Kirk has never lost sight of his childhood dream. To explore, to see new worlds and meet new civilizations... To boldly go, where no-one has gone before.

name: TOS Spock
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: TOS ENTERPRISE CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

They say a Captain is only as good as his First Officer. If that is indeed the case, then Captain Kirk can rest easy knowing that his First Officer is one of the finest in the galaxy.
Spock, a given name as his full name is unpronounceable to humans, is a human/Vulcan hybrid born on Vulcan in 2230. His hybrid status caused him no shortage of pain in his childhood, but the love of his mother and the wisdom of his father allowed him to overcome his aggressors.
A prodigy even by Vulcan standards, Spock was destined for greatness. He was even granted a place in the prestigious Vulcan Science Academy, which he declined in favor of Starfleet.
He was granted a place on the Enterprise, where he served as Captain Pike’s Science Officer. He forged a close relationship with his Captain and was intended to eventually take over command of the vessel.
However, through a series of unexpected events, command of the Enterprise went to James T. Kirk, a result which neither pleased nor disappointed Spock. Command simply exists, and he will do whatever is logical.
With Spock’s sage wisdom and unshakeable composure, he was able to guide the Enterprise and its Captain through their many trials.

name: Ten of Eleven
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

Tribbles are a fuzzy, simple species that are widely considered harmless, once their reproductive nature is kept under control. However, beneath their furry exterior lies the potential for galactic ruin. The Borg understand that the secrets to the Tribbles’ rapid asexual reproduction could be used as a weapon of mass destruction. 10 of 11 is the first test and if the Borg are not stopped, millions of this fluffy terror will flood across our universe.

name: The Doctor
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: VOYAGER
FACTION: FEDERATION

A self-proclaimed embodiment of modern medicine, The Doctor is the Emergency Medical Hologram and chief medical officer of the Federation starship Voyager. When Voyager was abducted by a being known as the Caretaker and transported over 70,000 lightyears away to the Delta Quadrant, the crew endured heavy casualties; the ship’s chief physician among them. This tragic loss would result in The Doctor’s activation by Ensign Harry Kim. Although originally intended for short-term activation, Voyager’s precarious situation and isolation so far from home would see The Doctor promoted to full-time service as the new chief physician.
Despite enduring a perilous journey home, The Doctor has developed a sophisticated array of emotions and interests. From brief indulgences in creative writing to practicing classical Italian opera, The Doctor’s pursuits and hobbies have helped him to break free from the confines of the matrices and subroutines that should have defined him. Subsequently, The Doctor would become a remarkable and valued member of the crew, earning the respect of his peers and friendship of his colleagues in the process.

name: The Hierarch
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: STATUS CONTROL TEAM
FACTION: THE NODE

As the Borg made their way through the Delta Quadrant, they efficiently and mercilessly assimilated any species they encountered into the Collective. Over the eons, countless civilizations and differing ways of life have been lost to the Borg hivemind. For the Kis’yhn, a once-peaceful humanoid species hailing from the Delta Quadrant, their encounter with the Borg would be no different. Assimilated and catalogued as Species 1862, the Kis’yhn’s way of life was decimated and erased from existence. Now, they would be forced to be nothing more than another node in the Borg’s network. And yet, despite the loss of everything they once held dear, a single spark remained that would soon light the fires of their resistance.

Following their assimilation, a lone Kis’yhn would prove to be incompatible with the Borg hivemind, retaining a semblance of their original identity that could not be erased. Their resistance was quickly recognized by the Borg Queen as a “virus” that could soon propagate throughout the entire Collective. In acknowledgment of this threat, the Borg Queen ordered the severance of the Kis’yhn contingent, condemning them to remain lost and adrift in the Delta Quadrant, as the Collective moved on without them.
 
However, the Kis’yhn would not be so easily forgotten. Utilizing the Borg technology that had been forced upon them, they returned to their homeworld and consolidated their power. There, they discovered Transogen, a naturally occurring element found deep beneath the mantle of the planet. Transogen would soon prove to be their lifeblood. Not only could it be embedded into the systems of the reclaimed Borg technology, making it their own in the process, but it would also serve as a conduit for the influence of the one who inspired the Kis’yhn’s resistance against the Borg. This once-lowly Kis’yhn has now risen up as the Hierarch of a new order. Under the banner of the Node, the Hierarch pursues only one goal - revenge against the Borg.

name: Three Of Eleven
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: NONE

Once considered one of the most intelligent and beautiful members of Vulcan society, much of that has been washed away by the Borg’s assimilation process, leaving T’Pring a husk of her former self. Now deployed as a ruthless and efficient drone, Three of Eleven is used to help expand the Borg’s range of influence and turmoil. Whatever existed of this matriarch to a happy family has become another soldier in the Borg’s ongoing mission to control the galaxy.

name: Toryn
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: MIRROR UNIVERSE
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

Not many experts of antiquities are also at home being threatened, shot at, and chased to the very edges of the known galaxy. But Toryn is one such Independent - someone who’s as comfortable at the helm as he is haggling over an ancient artifact. Some would label him a thief, but he would object to such a reductive description. He’s also independent in more than just his political loyalties - he had to be, leaving Andoria as a child, and fending for himself until he could make ends meet. But he wears his past as a badge of honor, because that’s how he mastered his craft.

Known to sometimes move people as well as goods, Toryn is deft at skirting galactic law when he needs to, and claims he can run rings around any Federation starship. That would be, in part, thanks to his trusty old faithful, the Realta. As with much that comes Toryn’s way, the ship was likely acquired from a dubious enterprise. But just like Toryn, you underestimate the Realta at your peril! Especially when it’s crewed with his ragtag gang of fellow galactic misfits: Sesha, Kuron, and Elea.

As their de facto leader, Toryn usually has his hands full. So if there’s one thing he would change about his arrangement, it would be to offload some of that responsibility, even if it means sharing more of the spoils. But only to an Independent Commander who has proved themselves worthy. If you’re willing, Toryn is extremely able.

name: Trelane
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: STRANGE NEW WORLDS
FACTION: Q CONTINUUM

Few beings are as bewildering as Trelane, the enigmatic ruler of Gothos. His abilities are so extraordinary as to defy the known laws of physics. Summoning matter from nothing, reshaping his surroundings with the wave of a hand, manipulating space and time as though they were toys to be picked up and cast aside at will - all in the blink of an eye. Yet despite his seemingly limitless power, Trelane remains a captive audience of the theater of humanity.

Fascinated by Earth’s Age of Sail, military traditions, and aristocratic customs, Trelane created wondrous settings and props to stage elaborate games with unsuspecting starship crews as his unwilling playmates. To Trelane, history was something best explored and learned through performance, and who better to play the leading role than himself? Beneath the bravado, however, was an inquisitive mind grappling with the alien concepts of compassion, responsibility, sacrifice, and the weight of genuine command.

Captain Kirk ultimately exposed the childish nature beneath Trelane’s grand theatrics, revealing an innocence hidden behind the trickster facade. Trelane, for all his immense power, is still a child who lacks the experience to truly grasp his own abilities. What might such a being become once boundless curiosity gives way to wisdom?

name: Trip Tucker
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: ENTERPRISE NX-01
FACTION: FEDERATION

Charles Tucker III was born in Panama City, Florida in the year 2121. Affectionately known as “Trip” among family and friends, Tucker acquired the nickname by being the third Tucker male in three consecutive generations to be given the name “Charles.” A young Tucker harbored aspirations of being a Starfleet captain from a young age, but the persuasion of his father - along with a reverence of the inventor Emory Erickson - would later see him focus on engineering as a primary discipline. 

Although he joined Starfleet in 2139, it would not be until 2151 when, under the rank of commander, Tucker was assigned as chief engineer of the Enterprise NX-01. During its time in active service, the Enterprise NX-01 would remain under Tucker’s diligent observation and maintenance. His affinity for mechanical engineering and natural charisma would see Tucker become a trusted and beloved member of the Enterprise crew. 

Tucker’s final act of service to Starfleet came in 2161. Following the successful rescue of Shran’s daughter Talla from Rigel X, the Enterprise was intercepted and boarded by Talla's would-be captors. With his captain’s life directly under threat, Tucker’s ingenuity and bravery would see him lure the assailants into one of the ship’s plasma junctions, which had been rigged for detonation. While the ensuing blast eliminated all threats onboard the ship, it would also claim Tucker’s life in the process. Although Tucker valiantly gave his life to save that of his captain, his sacrifice was not to be in vain. Captain Archer’s survival and presence at the signing of the Federation Charter would ensure the formation of the United Federation of Planets - a fitting tribute and legacy to one of Starfleet’s most gifted engineers.

name: V'ger Ilia
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: THE MOTION PICTURES
FACTION: FEDERATION

Lieutenant Ilia served as navigator during the inaugural flight of the refitted U.S.S. Enterprise, when it left Earth to face the incoming V’ger entity. There she was reunited with her former romantic partner, Will Decker, whom she’d met years earlier on her homeworld of Delta IV. As well as performing her duties, Ilia cared deeply for the well-being of her crewmates. When fellow lieutenant, Pavel Chekov, sustained a serious plasma burn during the V’ger incident, Ilia used her innate pain-relieving ability to soothe him, before medical help arrived. However, as the Enterprise ventured deeper into V’ger’s energy cloud, it was Ilia herself who came under attack. V’ger probed the bridge with a devastating beam, which targeted Ilia and vaporized her before the eyes of her friends and colleagues.

But this was not the end of her story. Encoded as a data pattern within V’ger’s vast imaging archive, the entity brought her back as a mechanical probe, sent to the Enterprise to communicate with its crew, or “carbon units” as V’ger called them, which it believed had infested the ship. The Ilia Probe was a replica right down to the smallest detail - at least on the outside. But inside it was composed of micro-miniature hydraulics, sensors, and molecule-sized multiprocessor chips. Yet V’ger had created too perfect a replica, because the Probe retained Ilia’s memories and feelings - especially towards Decker - which it began to recall, even choosing to adorn itself with Ilia’s Deltan headband.

When V’ger was revealed to be a sentient and augmented 20th-century space probe, which wanted to join with its creator, Decker immediately stepped forward. V’ger merged with Decker, and thus Ilia as well, creating an entirely new form of life. Neither were recorded as deceased, however, but rather missing in action. Now, Ilia lives on within this incorporeal entity, traveling the universe on a journey of discovery.

name: VIL Gul Dukat
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: VILLAINS
FACTION: CARDASSIAN

No other Cardassians could compare with Gul Dukat with regard to the number of challenges he has faced and the atrocities he has committed. After leaving Bajor and suffering numerous demotions, he has led multiple conspiracies and plots to restore his position in Cardassian society. In a pivotal move, he even struck an alliance with the Dominion, becoming their leader for a brief moment. However, a tremendous defeat in the Dominion War and the death of his beloved daughter, Ziyal, led him to madness and indomitable hate towards anything Bajoran, especially the Prophets.

After studying their religious text, Dukat designed a plan to destroy the Bajoran people and his nemesis, the Emissary. The exasperated Cardassian conducted a ritual to become a vessel for the Pah-wraiths, and Dukat subsequently attacked the Prophets in an attempt to leave the Bajorans without their protectors. However, these efforts would prove futile, as the Pah-wraiths were still trapped in the Fire Caves of Bajor, limiting their abilities. Dukat underwent cosmetic surgery to fool Winn Adami, a religious leader of Bajor, and used her to get the Book of the Kosst Amojan. Surprisingly, he found an ally in Winn, and together they conspired to release the Pah-wraiths from their imprisonment in the hopes of acquiring the power they both craved.

This alliance would be short-lived following Winn Adami's betrayal, as she poisoned Dukat to sacrifice him to the Pah-wraiths. Much to Winn’s horror, the Cardassian returned to life as the Emissary and an actual vessel of the evil Pah-wraiths. The only thing that ultimately stopped Dukat from setting the Alpha Quadrant aflame was a change of Winn’s heart, as she gave her life to protect Benjamin Sisko, trapping Dukat forever in the Fire Caves in the process. But in one of the other Universes, Winn stepped aside and let Dukat emerge victorious, as his rage and inner fire set the Alpha Quadrant ablaze.

name: VIL Winn Adami
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: VILLAINS
FACTION: BAJORAN

Winn Adami of the alternate dimension, just like her Prime Universe counterpart, has been many things: a prisoner of war, a preacher of the Bajoran religion, a ranjen, a vedek, and a kai, even the first minister of Bajor. Ever-ambitious and masterfully manipulative, Winn made her way up the Bajoran society, fueled by unbending loyalty to her people and burning ambition.  However, her only true goal - joining the Prophets as an Emissary - was snatched away by an alien, a human named Benjamin Sisko.

Being a Bajoran spiritual leader meant conversing with the gods, listening to them, and following their every word, but what if the Prophets never reply to your prayers? After decades of failures and doubts, years of serving the ungrateful and deaf gods, Winn Adami started to doubt her beliefs, and Pah-wraiths, evil deities and enemies of the Bajoran Prophets, took advantage of her. They deceived her with false visions and sent a disguised Gul Dukat to gain access to the Book of the Kosst Amojan - an ancient tome capable of releasing them from the Fire Caves of Bajor, where they have been trapped for millennia. Blinded by potential power and the chance to become an Emissary, she rejected the Prophets and dedicated herself to becoming a vessel for the Pah-wraiths, even if it meant colluding with the person she had hated the most - Dukat.

Deep within the Fire Caves, Winn Adami attempted to murder her partner in the hope that this sacrifice would grant her the long-sought title of the Pah-wraith Emissary, but, instead, she was once again rejected by the gods in favor of what she regarded to be an alien being. In the Prime Universe, Winn decides to sacrifice herself in the name of the Prophets and the greater good to protect the Alpha Quadrant, but this Winn Adami never makes this choice. She allowed Dukat to win, and had to live with the consequences as the fiery rage of Pah-wraiths was unleashed, and millions of people she had once sworn to protect perished.

name: WOK Carol Marcus
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: FEDERATION
FACTION: WRATH OF KHAN

Among other vital doctrines such as peace, justice and equality, a unified pursuit of scientific discovery was one of the core foundational principles of the United Federation of Planets. By gaining further understanding of the forces that governed existence itself, member states of the Federation who were once considered disparate entities instead sought to thrive and prosper under a single banner. Perhaps one of the greatest scientific minds of her time, Doctor Carol Marcus was among the Federation’s leading scientists in the 23rd century.

As head scientist and chief architect of “Project Genesis”, Dr. Marcus endeavored to create “life from lifelessness”. Following the deployment of Genesis on a barren planet, the molecular structure of the planet itself was reorganized at the subatomic level into life-generating matter of equal mass. A dead moon could instead be transformed into a living, breathing planet capable of sustaining life. Genesis was to be the culmination of Dr. Marcus’ life’s work. However, when her research fell into the hands of one Khan Noonien Singh, Dr. Marcus was to instead realize the destructive potential of Genesis, should it fall into the wrong hands.

Following a brief relationship with James T. Kirk, Dr. Marcus gave birth to their son, David. Although he retained the capacity to be an influential father figure in David’s life, Carol knew deep inside that Kirk’s place was on the bridge of a starship, exploring strange, new worlds. She instead chose to raise David alone, a decision that would see David’s brilliant scientific potential realized - a potential that closely matched his mother’s.

name: WOK Joachim
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: WRATH OF KHAN
FACTION: WRATH OF KHAN

In the latter years of the 20th century, the natural charisma and leadership displayed by Khan Noonien Singh garnered him many devoted followers. Perhaps none were more dedicated to their faith than Joachim. With his legion of genetically-engineered “Augments”, Khan would lead a revolution that would become known as the Eugenics Wars. Following their defeat at the conclusion of this conflict, Joachim found himself among a contingent of the most loyal followers who would join Khan in exodus aboard the sleeper ship Botany Bay. Out there, among the stars, they would escape their would-be captors and awaken from cryogenic slumber in order to build a new life.

When the Botany Bay was discovered by the U.S.S. Enterprise more than 70 years later, Khan attempted to hijack the ship in order to continue this pursuit of prosperity. However, when these efforts backfired, the Augments instead found themselves exiled to the barren sands of Ceti Alpha V. Here, Khan would eventually abandon his quest to find a home for his people, instead opting for the path of vengeance against those who banished them to this place.

Throughout all of Khan’s futile pursuits of dominance and revenge, Joachim stood by his side as a stalwart ally and advisor, his faith unwavering. Although his attempts to provide sound knowledge and counsel often fell on deaf ears, Joachim nonetheless trusted to the very end that Khan would act in the best interests of his genetically-engineered followers.

name: WOK Montgomery Scott
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: FEDERATION
FACTION: WRATH OF KHAN

Of all the crew who walked the hallowed hallways and served on the prestigious decks of the U.S.S. Enterprise and its subsequent iterations, perhaps none were as intimately acquainted with the ship as its Chief Engineer, Montgomery “Scotty” Scott. For almost three decades, Scotty devoted himself to the continued maintenance of his beloved ship, ensuring that the name “Enterprise” became synonymous with excellence in the annals of Federation history. From encounters with fearsome Klingon fleets, to standoffs with unyielding Romulan warbirds, there was no threat capable of standing in the way of Scotty and his ability to realize the full potential of the Enterprise.

Although he would be the first person to refute his given title, Scotty was known throughout Starfleet ranks as an eminent “miracle worker”. However, no single miracle could alter the events that transpired following the reemergence of Khan Noonien Singh and his subsequent plot to steal the Genesis Device. Following Khan’s defeat at the conclusion of a fierce battle in the Mutara Nebula, Scotty bore witness to the valiant sacrifice made by Captain Spock, who would give his very life in order to prevent the destruction of the Enterprise. Not only had Spock saved Scotty’s life, he also saved the very ship that Scotty loved so dearly. As a small token of recompense, Scotty would volunteer to pay tribute to his fallen comrade by playing the bagpipes during Spock’s funeral.

name: Weyoun
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: DEEP SPACE NINE
FACTION: DOMINION

What is the true measure of loyalty? Some might say it lies in unending devotion, until one’s own demise.
If this is the case, Weyoun has proven his loyalty several times over.
Like all the Vorta, the self-described “emissaries” of the Dominion, Weyoun, as we know him, is a clone. The original Weyoun is long dead, though his undying devotion to the Dominion can be seen in his successors, each of them bringing a new improvement to the line of Weyouns, a new mark on their noble progenitor’s legacy.
Despite minor differences in personality, each Weyoun shares some common traits. He is a shrewd politician and a relentless negotiator. He will stop at nothing to ensure the Founders’ will is done, regardless of the cost.

name: William T. Riker
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: TNG CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

William Thomas Riker is the First Officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise-D, holding the rank of Commander. Riker’s impressive resumé includes a stint on board the U.S.S. Hood, under Captain DeSoto, and as an operations officer aboard the U.S.S. Potemkin.

Riker was given the nickname of “Number One” by Captain Jean-Luc Picard shortly after their first meeting; a moniker that has followed him since. As one of the most charismatic and popular members of the Enterprise crew, Riker is a constant when it comes to social gatherings as well as official functions. He takes part in contests such as Anbo-jyutsu and the infamous team sport of Parrises Squares. He is responsible for organizing a regular poker night with other members of the senior staff. Riker is also an accomplished trombone player and champion marksman with a phaser.

William Riker is a man who is brave in the face of adversity and willing to do his utmost for the Federation. His loyalty is without question, and his honor is his bond.

name: Zefram Cochrane
bio:
CLASS: Engineering
GROUP: FIRST CONTACT MOVIE
FACTION: INDEPENDENT

Every member of Starfleet has heard about Zefram Cochrane - the legendary historical figure, who, together with Lily Sloane, invented the first warp drive in human history, initiated first contact with the Vulcans, and, in doing so, changed the fate of Earth for the better. But only a rare few truly know the history behind the Phoenix’s creation and Cochrane’s early life. 

A survivor of World War III, Cochrane had no intention of changing the world - on the contrary, he sought easy money and early retirement, surrounded by women and alcohol on a tropical island. The ship that would bring the world together was intended as yet another military invention, ironically built with a nuclear missile casing. However, when the Borg travelled into the past in an attempt to prevent the first contact with the Vulcans, as the Enterprise-E crew followed closely behind, Cochrane’s plans were to change. With the help of valiant Starfleet officers, he completed the construction of the Phoenix and became the first Human to travel at faster-than-light speed, ushering in a new era for Earth.

His later life turned out to be just as mysterious and adventurous. In the eyes of the public, Cochrane fully embraced the life that the others have designated for him by taking the role of an inventive and open-minded engineer, a visionary, and simply a great man who paved the way to the distant stars. It was among these very stars where Cochrane disappeared at the age of eighty-seven, never to be seen again... Or so they say.

name: Ahvix
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: OUTLAWS
FACTION: NONE

Ahvix is a visitor to our galaxy, albeit an unwilling one. After an incident with her ship, Ahvix found herself stranded here, in the company of Mudd and his crew of Rogues. At first, they were unsure of this unknown alien but Ahvix quickly proved herself as a reliable and skilled officer and became an invaluable asset to the crew.
While she still searches for a way home to this day, Ahvix has found something most unexpected in this strange, new galaxy... Friends.

name: Alok Sahar
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: SECTION 31
FACTION: SECTION 31

Alok Sahar believes that the past always catches up with anyone running from it - and he has been trying to escape his own for centuries. His transformation into an Augment happened against his wishes: Giri the Marked, an Augment, slaughtered his family but spared Alok, only to later transform him into one of her own. Alok became an unwilling part of the Augment ranks and wreaked havoc on Earth during the Eugenics Wars. However, when the Augments lost the war, Alok was exiled into stasis along with his newfound Augment brethren. Centuries passed before he saw the light of day again, and it was Section 31 that brought him back. Yet, there is always a price to be paid for redemption of this magnitude. Alok’s price was to atone for his sins by doing the Federation’s dirty work.
Inhumanely strong, agile, and intelligent, Alok Sahar is the perfect secret agent material, capable of completing any assigned task, no matter the challenge it may present. Control assigned him to lead the Alpha Team to find Philippa Georgiou and seek her help in stopping a mysterious weapon from getting into the wrong hands. Their mission saved the Prime Universe from overwhelming destruction by the Godsend and the Terran Empire invasion, but it also liberated Alok from his past, as he found someone who could understand him like nobody else - Georgiou. He was ready to accompany her in the sacrifice to destroy the Crescent Nebula, which was concealing a portal to the Mirror Universe. However, Lieutenant Rachel Garrett and Quasi managed to save them at the last second, giving both a chance for a new life. The worries of their past had instead been replaced with hopes for their future.

name: Alonzo Freeman
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: LOWER DECKS
FACTION: FEDERATION

After the construction of Starfleet HQ in the early 22nd century, many San Franciscan residents for decades to come would dedicate their lives to enlist in the Federation’s exploratory and defense service. Generational enlistment would become a common occurrence among Bay Area families - sons and daughters would often walk in the footsteps of their elders, enlisting as cadets in Starfleet Academy as their parents once did. A prime example of such a household is kept by Admiral Alonzo “Zo” Freeman.

Along with his wife, Captain Carol Freeman, the pair share parentage of Ensign Beckett Mariner - a combined effort and labor of love that has put strain on their marriage on numerous occasions. Although the Freemans make sure that diligent service to Starfleet runs in the family, Mariner’s resistance to fall in line continues to be a frequent thorn in her parents’ sides. Nonetheless, Alonzo Freeman continues to balance the responsibilities of parentage and admiralty in equal measure.

Throughout the storied history of Starfleet, many Admirals have been corrupted by the power provided to them by their rank. Thankfully, Admiral Freeman remains untempted by the allure of such things. A paragon of the ideas that Starfleet and the Federation were originally founded on, other less scrupulous Starfleet admirals would do well to follow Freeman’s example.

name: Arrock
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: FERENGI CONGLOMERATE
FACTION: FERENGI

The elder of the two Ferengi brothers who were mentored by Quark, Arrock is something of an impulsive hot head, which hasn’t exactly made him the ideal business owner. However, his stubborn streak makes him an excellent negotiator, always walking away on the winning side of every deal. Balanced out by his brother’s more aloof nature, he has managed to make a decent name for himself in the cut-throat world of Ferengi enterprise.

name: Ash Tyler
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: DISCOVERY
FACTION: FEDERATION

Many of us are dealt a bad hand in life. While some might lament their misfortune, others turn their bad luck into opportunities. Then, there are people like Ash Tyler, who take that hand and throw it back in your face.
Ash grew up on Earth, near Washington D.C. He lived a simple life along with his mother. The two had little, but they had each other. Ash enlisted in Starfleet in the hopes of securing a better life for both of them.
He served honorably aboard the U.S.S. Yeager until the Battle at the Binary Stars. There, he was captured, tortured, and subjected to horrific experiments. He had just about given up hope of escape until he was rescued by Captain Gabriel Lorca.
Lorca gave Tyler a second chance and a spot on his bridge. Ash leaped at the chance and went on to prove himself as a capable and relentlessly loyal security officer.

name: Azetbur
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: KLINGON PATRIOTS
FACTION: KLINGON EMPIRE

Azetbur is Gorkon's daughter, and is known for decisive follow-through in battle. Her study of the sciences has provided her father tactical advantages in several engagements. Despite the lowly tricks inherent in using quirks of physics to attain victory, there is nothing more honorable than victory.

name: B'Elanna Torres
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: VOYAGER
FACTION: FEDERATION

The child of a Human father and Klingon mother, B’Elanna Torres spent her formative years growing up on the Federation colony Kessik IV. After her father left home while B’Elanna was still young, she grew resentful of her Klingon heritage, citing it as the reason for her father’s abandonment of his wife and child. After a brief tenure in Starfleet Academy, B'Elanna dropped out of her enrolment and spent a number of months in search of a different purpose. When a Bolian freighter she was traveling aboard was attacked by Cardassian forces, her life was saved by Commander Chakotay and the forces of the Maquis. This intervention motivated B’Elanna to enlist in the Maquis herself, inspired by her newfound purpose to fight back against the Cardassians.
In 2371, the SS Val Jean, along with B’Elanna and her fellow Maquis crew, was declared lost in the Badlands. In actuality, the vessel had been abducted by the Caretaker array and transported to the Delta Quadrant, along with the Federation starship Voyager. When the Val Jean was intercepted by Voyager, the Maquis crew were incorporated into Voyager’s roster. B’Elanna was among those assigned to the Engineering team, and was granted a provisional promotion to lieutenant junior grade.
Although reluctant to accept it in her rebellious youth, B’Elanna was a brilliant engineer who was capable of learning and adapting on the fly. After continuously proving herself to be an essential member of the crew, B’Elanna would eventually rise to the rank of chief engineer.

name: B'Etor
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: PRIDE OF ROMULUS
FACTION: ROMULAN

As one of the infamous Duras Sisters, B’Etor is responsible for much unrest throughout the Klingon Empire. As the right hand of her sister Lursa, the true power behind the House of Duras, B’Etor is known for being a swift hand of vengeance.

Despite her reputation as a vicious warrior, B’Etor has often used schemes and deception in her pursuit of glory. These characteristics have led her honor to be questioned continuously within the High Council, leading to many instances of disgrace for Duras. B’Etor’s true ambition is to see her sister puppeteering the strings of would-be leaders of the Klingon Empire, and she will strive for this goal by any means necessary.

name: Ba'el
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: KHITOMER'S REVENGE
FACTION: KLINGON

Home is a difficult concept for those who live in two worlds.

Ba’el is the daughter of a Romulan and a Klingon, a living contrast who never knew the reality of life outside of her peaceful commune. She was content to live a simple, quiet life with her family and friends, far from the worries of the galaxy.

That was, until she met Worf.

Ba’el immediately fell in love with this strange Starfleet officer, though it was not fully reciprocated. Even when her family turned on him, when her people were ready to kill him, she stood by his side. It was thanks to her that Worf made it back to the Enterprise in one piece.

Loyal, determined and with a will of iron, Ba’el shows the best qualities of both Romulans and Klingons.

name: Barot
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: MINERS & SURVEYORS
FACTION: NONE

Barot is a self-exiled Klingon, disinterested in warfare, honor, or most of the other trappings of Klingon society. Unsurprisingly, many Klingons treat him as a pariah, despite his numerous useful skills as a surveyor.

name: Beverly Crusher
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: TNG CREW
FACTION: FEDERATION

As the Chief Medical Officer on the U.S.S. Enterprise-D, Doctor Beverly Crusher balances her renowned booksmarts with a strong sense of empathy for all those she treats. Furthermore, she also acts as something of a mother figure and unofficial therapist for the rest of the Enterprise crew, her reputation for being a great listener and giving out insightful advice preceding her.
However, even with her usually gentle and caring nature, there is a steel inside Dr. Crusher that has allowed her to step up into a leadership role when needed. Able to make the tough decisions, and commanding the respect of those around her, Doctor Crusher has even helped the Enterprise crew survive a Borg attack through her quick thinking and decisive actions.

name: Brad Boimler
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: LOWER DECKS
FACTION: FEDERATION

Ensign Bradward Boimler has always known that he was meant for the Captain’s chair, and he will do whatever it takes to get there. Whether it’s baking his Captain's favorite cookies, or joining the Redshirt Club to help him climb the Starfleet ladder, Boimler has proven that he is serious about ranking up. He even went so far as to program an advanced holodeck program using the crew’s personal logs to prepare for an interview with Captain Freeman.  

Unfortunately, Boimler’s dependence on rules and protocol does not always work in his favor. In focusing so hard on what he should be doing and what will make him promotable, Boimler often fails to react to the situation at hand. Luckily, his friend and “mentor” Beckett Mariner is there to provide a little chaos and mischief to keep Boimler on his feet. Though he tries to be the voice of reason and authority, he is slowly learning that sometimes breaking the rules is necessary to get the job done. 

To date, Boimler’s most significant contribution as a Starfleet officer has been the Boimler Effect, which, to his dismay, is a mandate that encourages shortcuts and discourages blindly following the rules. In the far future, Ensign Bradward Boimler will come to be known as "the laziest, most corner-cutting officer in Starfleet history".

name: Byr Ch'Kelrer
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: SYMBIOSIS
FACTION: NONE

It’s not easy when no one around you recognizes your genius, when everyone you have to deal with has the intellect of a Cardassian snapple pea and just goes on and on obsessively about empirical rigor and petty ethics. But that’s the curse of Byr Ch’Kelrer, an Andorian scientist officially disbarred from the Andorian Institute of Science for what they foolishly called “immoral, dangerous behavior”. 

All Byr wants to do is add to the sum total of knowledge in the universe, and if that means that from time to time a laboratory explodes or a basic lifeform mutates into a slavering, flesh-eating monster, well surely that’s a small price to pay. 

In the meantime, Byr has to make do with putting his considerable skills to use aboard the vessel of Trill adventurer Masriad Vael, operating at the edges of the law, helping to liberate some of the galaxy’s rarest and most valuable items from the galaxy’s most undeserving. It’s the kind of business that often calls for the rapid cerebral inventiveness of a scientific mastermind. 

The traveling lab isn’t so bad, either.

name: Caleb Mir
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: STARFLEET ACADEMY
FACTION: FEDERATION

A difficult childhood. A chip on his shoulder. A rap sheet as long as he is tall. Caleb Mir is not the obvious choice for admittance into the Starfleet Academy program, yet here he is, taking to training better than anyone would have thought - himself most of all. 

Though he is settling into life at the Academy - making friends, joining teams, daydreaming about a certain Betazoid - Caleb remains haunted by his past. By the trial that took his mother away from him, by the man behind it all. Nus Braka. 

But one thing is certain. Caleb will not rest until he has found his mother, and not even the galaxy’s most fearsome pirate will stand in his way.

name: Captain Tilly
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: TERRAN EMPIRE
FACTION: NONE

Unlike her U.S.S. Discovery counterpart, Captain Tilly is charismatic, ruthless, and bloodthirsty. Leaving a trail of destruction in her wake in any system she targets, her reputation has garnered her several nicknames, including “The Slayer of Sorna Prime”, “The Witch of Wurna Minor", and “Captain Killy” – each of which she relishes.

name: Cath
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: FERENGI CONGLOMERATE
FACTION: FERENGI

The typical role of the female in Ferengi culture is one of subjugation and oppression. Driven by patriarchal laws and cultural standards, Ferengi society highly discouraged females from the pursuit of profit or independence. While compliance with these norms was commonplace, a number of Ferengi women throughout history have absconded from their expected roles in Ferengi society, and have instead opted to pursue their own aspirations and desires. Albeit later in life, Cath would eventually join their ranks with her own story to tell.

Having complied with Ferengi customs long enough to see her only son, Gavah, grow into a successful profiteer, Cath would find herself at a moral crossroads following the death of her husband. Disillusioned with everyday life on Ferenginar, Cath looked within and found a singular aspiration - to become established as an Independent operator, working to help those who would find themselves in need of her services.

With the help of Maia and the Commander, and with some resistance from Gavah, Cath would soon realize her aspirations and appoint herself as Stationmaster of her very own Independent installation. Cath’s operation continues to expand to this day - a testament to her own resilience, and a shining beacon of inspiration to those who would dare to dream of bigger things.

name: Chang
bio:
CLASS: COMMAND
GROUP: KLINGON PATRIOTS
FACTION: KLINGON EMPIRE

Chang is a Klingon of the old ways through and through, despite his cultured affectation. He is seen as merciless by the enemies of the Empire, as he has repeatedly fired upon fleeing vessels, civilian ships, and escape pods.

name: Changeling Kira
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: DEEP SPACE NINE
FACTION: FEDERATION

This Changeling operative was working in secret to infiltrate the Federation, having planted itself as an imposter on Deep Space Nine. 

Originating from The Great Link, the Changelings, or Founders, are a deeply secretive race, known as the rulers of the Dominion, a galactic civilization that spans much of the Gamma Quadrant.

Changeling can take the form of other individuals, or even objects, and are extremely difficult to detect. Little is known about this particular Changeling operative, other than the fact that she escaped capture by Starfleet and is now once again out in the wild.

name: Damar
bio:
CLASS: ENGINEERING
GROUP: DS9
FACTION: CARDASSIAN

Damar is a patriotic Cardassian who has often been thrust into the limelight, largely due to his association with the notorious Gul Dukat. Damar spent the majority of his career ranked as a Glinn, floating between assignments, attempting to see the wider quadrant in his service to Cardassia. Damar’s primary motivator is to provide for his wife and son, who live on Cardassia Prime. As a devoted husband and father, the only thing that he loves more than his family is his home. This devotion has brought about a deep resentment towards Bajorans, particularly anyone directly involved in the Bajoran resistance, or linked to the end of the occupation. This blind narrow-mindedness accentuates Damar’s lack of creativity and his lack of subtlety, often getting him into trouble with his superiors.

However, through hard work, determination, and some luck, Damar often finds himself in the right place at the right time. He was instrumental in a plot to stop barbarous Klingons from raiding Cardassian supply lines, and with the aid of Gul Dukat and Major Kira of Bajor, successfully commandeered a Klingon Bird of Prey. This highlight of Damar’s is one that has caught the attention of the Cardassian Central Command.

Perhaps there is a bright future in store for Damar...

name: Decius
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: ROMULAN PATRIOTS
FACTION: ROMULAN STAR EMPIRE

Decius has served under multiple commanders throughout his career. His friends on the senate have ensured that he finds preferable appointments; he has served repeatedly against the Klingons, and has become intimately familiar with their strengths and weaknesses.

name: Dezoc
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: UNIMATRIX TWELVE
FACTION: BORG

Since the Federation’s first official contact with the Borg in 2365, many humans have become assimilated by the Collective. Dezoc was a mediocre member of Starfleet, diligent and conscientious, but not talented enough to make it to the starship’s bridge or any higher ranks, so the only option was to settle with the daily lower decks routine. Dezoc was busy at the reactor when the Collective attacked, and for that specific reason he couldn’t make it to the escape pod. 
However, being assimilated made Dezoc equal among other drones, where he matters just as much as others do, and even though he lost emotions, memories and any sense of individuality, there is something inside that makes him more effective and ruthless than any other drone.

name: Dixon Hill
bio:
CLASS: SCIENCE
GROUP: HOLODECK
FACTION: FEDERATION
